articleTitle: Neural Network Pattern Recognition for Assessment of Flood Susceptibility in Navotas City, Philippines
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Navotas is one of the most flood-prone cities in the Philippines. The present authors investigated the area of the city affected by the very high floods. The authors identified 13 factors that might affect the flood in the city. After identifying the factors, the respondents assess them using a 5-point Likert scale. The findings will be evaluated through similarities of responses using neural network pattern recognition. The results of the confusion matrix, receiver operating characteristic and cross entropy show dominance proving that the identified 13 factors are significant to the flood susceptibility in Navotas City, Philippines.

articleTitle: UX Evaluation of National Social Security Agency for Employment Using User Experience Questionnaire and Heuristic Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, also known as Bpjamsostek, is the entity responsible for administering employment-related social security initiatives in Indonesia. Bpjamsostek offers administrative services to its clients through in-person channels and a mobile application. The given mobile application is titled JMO. Bpjamsostek consistently maintains and updates this mobile application, progressively influencing the user experience. During the period of this study, the JMO application was rated 4.7 out of5 stars. However, out of the most recent 100 reviews, it was discovered that 20 consumers awarded a rating of 1 star. This points to a shift in user experience that may result in a decline in ratings in the future. The objective of this research is to support Bpjamsostek by assessing and offering suggestions for enhancing future updates of JMO. The study will assess the interface through Heuristic Evaluation (HE) and evaluate the entire user experience utilizing the User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ). The study entails the involvement of three experts who will evaluate the interface using heuristic evaluation (HE). Additionally, 460 participants will take part in assessing the user experience with the User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ). The study's findings will be communicated via a wireframe, and the research results will be utilized to provide suggestions to the bpjamsostek development team for improving the JMO user experience.

articleTitle: The Influence of Measuring Location on Volume Estimation by Shadow Casting Method
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Non-contact inspection has dominated various industries for many years, particularly in the field of food and agricultural processes. Volume estimation can be achieved by volumetric imagery or 3D reconstruction. The casting of shadows or shape by shading is an active technique that can be utilized to generate volumetric imagery. By evaluating the length of shadows, the object height data can be achieved, and the transformation of image coordinates to world coordinates is facilitated by means of homography transformation. The width, length, and height of object edges along the entirety of its length are employed to reconstruct virtual slices. The integration of these virtual slices enables the estimation of the object's volume. This research studied the variation of the measuring locations, three different diameters spherical balls 38mm, 50mm, and 80mm are used as test materials. The percentage of errors in volume obtained from all sections by shadow casting were compared to computation volume of sphere formula is approximately -1.6 %, -1.13 %, and - 6.60%, respectively, depending on the size of the object. Furthermore, a visualization-based analysis is presented which has no significant difference. From this studied, it can be concluded that this method is valuable in estimating the volume of axially symmetrical objects.

articleTitle: Impact of Internet Self-Efficacy on Digital Citizenship in a Constructionist Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In a constructionist learning environment, as technology becomes integrated into education, it is crucial to explore how students' self-efficacy in using online tools affects their dedication to responsible digital behavior. This paper investigates the relationship between internet self-efficacy and digital citizenship among high school students in a constructionist setting. The study involved 80 high school students chosen from a school that followed a constructionist learning method. Data analysis utilized Pearson's correlation coefficient. The results indicated a positive link between internet self-efficacy and digital citizenship in the constructionist learning setting. The study contributes to the knowledge of educational psychology, technology-enhanced learning, and digital citizenship.

articleTitle: Lifelog Tagging System Using Physiological Indicators
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: When recalling specific scenes later in life, we recall scenes that made a strong impression on us. A tagging system based on emotional swings is needed as a method to retrieve specific scenes from a long-time life log with less invasiveness to the user. In this paper, we propose a lifelog tagging system based on emotional swings, using heartbeats for emotion estimation. As an example of a lifelog, we tagged a horror movie, which tends to show emotional ups and downs. As an experimental result, we have achieved tagging our experiences by using our emotional status. Many of the scenes in which we felt emotional turmoil were impressive scenes. The challenge is to increase the number of types of emotions and to add more conditions to the environment.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis on Mobile Prosecutor Application Using System Usability Scale and PACMAD Method
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The Prosecutor's Office of the Republic of Indonesia is a law enforcement agency in Indonesia. The Prosecutor's Office of the Republic of Indonesia has several applications to help employees' work, one of which is the Mobile Prosecutor's Office. While the application is designed to support employee performance, but there have been complaints from users of the application in reviews on Playstore with a rating of 3.5. Several complaints from users were that there were still several bugs and errors appearing in the Mobile Prosecutor's application, so this research was carried out to analyze the User Experience through Usability Testing using the PACMAD and SUS methods. This test uses 7 aspects of PACMAD, which is effectiveness, efficiency, memory, errors, satisfaction, learning ability and cognitive load. The test results of 7 respondents using the PACMAD method and 23 respondents using the SUS method were employees of the Padang Lawas District Prosecutor's Office, the learnability aspect was 85,71%, the error aspect was 0,119 or 1,19%. the memorability aspect was 66,98%, the Effectiveness aspect was 71,42%, the Efficiency aspect was 0,01624 goal/sec, Cognitive Load was 54,46, the satisfaction aspect was 58. Based on the results of the analysis, recommendations for future improvements will be made for the application.

articleTitle: The Effect of Delivery Experience, Ease of Use, and Customer Satisfaction on Intention to Reuse Food Delivery Application in Jakarta
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: With over 215 million people using the internet, food delivery applications (FDAs) are clearly expanding quickly in Indonesia. People's lifestyles have changed as a result of the rapid growth of food delivery services. Food delivery applications have become incredibly popular in recent years, particularly during the COVID-19 pandemic. Providers of food delivery services also compete to offer delivery options that best meet the demands of the local community. The purpose of this research is to ascertain the impact of ease of use, delivery experiences, and customer satisfaction on consumers' intentions to re-use the Food Delivery Application (FDA). The research approach is based on primary data that has been collected from December 2023 to January 2024. The study's primary source of data was collected from participants who completed a questionnaire. The research population consisted of FDA users in Jakarta, with a total of 200 respondents. The IBM SPSS Statistic application was utilized for the data analysis of this study, along with three hypotheses. The findings of this study indicate that the delivery experiences, ease of use, and customer satisfaction affects the intention to reuse food delivery applications.

articleTitle: Quick Response Code Indonesia Standard (QRIS) Digital Payment Actual Use in MSMEs
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research aims to determine the influence of performance expectations, effort expectations, social influences, and facilitating conditions on behavioral intentions and actual use of the Quick Response Code Indonesia Standard (QRIS). The research method used is quantitative survey research. The population of this research is MSMEs that use QRIS in Tangerang City, Banten Province, Indonesia numbering around 11,000 companies and its surroundings by determining the sample size using the Slovin Formula of 99.99 units rounded up to 100 samples. This research produces that performance expectations and facilitating conditions have a positive and significant effect on behavioral intentions. Effort expectations and social expectations have a negative and insignificant effect on behavioral intentions. Behavioral intentions and facilitating conditions have a positive and significant effect on actual QRIS use.

articleTitle: $L_{1}$-Norm-Minimization-Based Tunable Stopband-Width Filter with Guaranteed-Stability
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The issue of designing a tunable stopband-width (SBW) digital filter with cascade-connected second-order building blocks is addressed in this paper. The stability of the entire tunable SBW filter is ensured via guaranteeing the stability of every second-order building block. To get a tunable SBW filter, a 2-step technique is adopted, which includes fixed SBW filter designs and then fitting the coefficients of the fixed SBW filters using different polynomials. The stability is guaranteed by using a special function to transform the filter's parameters, and the fixed SBW filters are designed by minimizing the overall absolute errors of the amplitude responses. A tunable SBW digital filter is designed for validating the SBW tunability as well as the guaranteed filter's stability.

articleTitle: Analyzing and Learning Semantic Transparency of Chinese Compound Words
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The Chinese language is quite complex, and each word carries multiple meanings. Thus, when two words are joined in compound words, the problem of interpreting their meaning intensifies. This research aims to analyze the semantic transparency of Chinese compound words based on the meaning of their components. This research employs a qualitative descriptive method, beginning with the selection of 600 vocabulary words from HSK Level 3. From these, a total of 258 compound words were chosen as the data, with a distribution of 152 noun compounds, 74 verb compounds, and 32 adjective compounds. The meanings of these compounds were analyzed based on semantic transparency, consisting of transparent and opaque meanings. The results of this research are expected to contribute to Chinese language learning, and by using the Wordwall game-based application, it can help the students better understand compound words, specifically Chinese-English compound words.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Accuracy of ChatGPT and Baidu Translate in Chinese Menu Translation
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The research assesses the precision of ChatGPT and Baidu Translate in translating Chinese menus, with a specific emphasis on promoting cross-cultural communication and comprehension in culinary settings. The study employs a method of comparative analysis to evaluate their ability to translate Chinese menus into English. The objectives of this research include the evaluate, compare, and identify processes. Through an evaluation process that consists of 5 categories from 103 Chinese menus, this research tries to compare the two translation results from two different types of AI tools, then continues to identify what factors influence the differences in the translation of the two AI tools. The results help us understand the strengths and weaknesses of ChatGPT and Baidu Translate in translating Chinese menus. This knowledge can be used to enhance machine translation algorithms, assist users in choosing the right tools, and lay the groundwork for future developments in language processing technology.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis on National Library of Republic Indonesia Mobile Application Using UEQ and Usability Testing
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Literacy defined as competence and skills in oral communication, reading, and writing in problem-solving and daily activities. Indonesia, as a developing country, has a relatively lower literacy level. Thus, innovation is essential to elevate literacy and enhance citizens' knowledge, science, and technology. The National Library of Indonesia introduced a nationwide online library, aiming to attract and engage readers throughout the country. However, users face difficulties, evident in low ratings (2.7 on App Store, 3.3 on Play Store), expressing dissatisfaction. The research employs a combination of methods User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ) and Usability Testing to examine user experiences, uncover needs, and optimize the national e-library for enhanced literacy and user satisfaction. The UEQ survey has 100 participants, and the Usability testing has 8 participants to finished the task scenarios. According to the UEQ survey's results, the efficiency scale received the lowest score with −0.40. However, the Usability Testing findings indicate that the mistake rate aspect has a high rate of 29.54% and the satisfaction aspect has a low score of 3.5 out of 5.0. These findings highlight the need for enhancements, especially in the user interface and experience of features like book recommendations and user profiles, as many users find these functions difficult to use. By implementing the recommendation, aims to improve the usability of applications, allowing users to feel more at ease when using the app, as well as more effective and efficient in its use.

articleTitle: Systematic Framework: Profiling Visual Attributes of Visually Impaired Students
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This paper employed the System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) to create a visual attribute profile for visually impaired students. The profile, drawn from a substantial dataset, considers age, tasks, and severity of impairments. It is crucial for inclusive education in blind and special schools, aiding teachers and physicians. Demographic information, including age, gender, education, medical records, and low vision aid prescriptions, is gathered. Visual attributes are assessed through comprehensive eye examinations, calculating students' visual demands based on classroom settings. The study follows the Waterfall Model within the SDLC, encompassing stages like requirement gathering and analysis, system design and implementation. Demographic data and visual attributes are integrated into big data, generating output based on calculated demands. Feedback from most of school database users underscores the importance of information on visual characteristics for effective management of visually impaired students. Notably, 67% highlight the current database's lack of such information. Thus, this profiling initiative is a strategic move toward addressing evidence-based visual characteristics and demands, providing valuable insights for educators, optometrists, and clinical instructors to tailor management strategies.

articleTitle: Menu Ordering Application using QR Code With User Experience Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The high level of coffee consumption in Indonesia is one of the causes of the growth of coffee shops in various regions, including in Bekasi. One of the places to eat in the area is a favorite of young people to gather and spend time together. To improve service and satisfaction with customers while at the restaurant, the owner wants to create an application that can speed up waiting times and minimize food delivery errors ordered by customers and queues at the cashier. In the study, a mobile website-based food and beverage menu order application was made. A menu ordering application is a system to manage the order and delivery of food and become a solution to transform menu ordering from a traditional way to a digital way by using an application. The application was created with two technologies, namely QR codes and RFID, that can increase the effective and efficient food and beverage menu ordering system compared to the previous way. Customers can also directly pay through the application without going to the cashier. The application development method is the Kanban method because it clearly describes tasks, subtasks, deadlines, and progress status. Based on the results of direct testing on 20 respondents who visited restaurants, as many as 65% said the menu order process became more accessible and faster. In contrast, 35% said the application was easy to use. Meanwhile, based on user acceptance test testing, the average performance of application functionality was 91.4%. Based on this data, the ordering process has become more effective, efficient, easy to understand, and easy to use.

articleTitle: Investigating Students' Speaking Anxiety in Computer-Mediated Classroom
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Over Covid-19 pandemic, online education was imposed internationally, replacing physical education. In online education, communication between students and teachers was done through educational technology such as video conferencing technology. Because of its anonymity nature, computer-mediated communication was considered more convenient for the students to speak up and participate actively in classroom discussion. However, most of the students were still reluctant to speak during online classroom, even when they were given the chance to speak without having to show their faces. In this study, we try to discover the underlying reasons for not speaking in online classroom. To collect the data, we used a quantitative survey questionnaire, which was distributed digitally to 80 English department students at a private university in Jakarta. It is found that the main reason for students' unwillingness to speak in the classroom is the limited time given by the teachers, followed by their anxiety of being judged and lack of confidence. This research concludes that students' reticence in the classroom is related to the teacher's teaching style and students' orientation of saving their own faces in front of the others.

articleTitle: Smart Flood Sensor System Using Arduino and GSM Module
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Floods are one of the annual natural disasters experienced by Malaysia and the rest of the world. Destruction of infrastructure, economic losses, and casualties are among the adverse effects of floods. When flood water comes into contact with electricity, it becomes very dangerous because of the risk of being electrocuted. Therefore, this study aims to develop a Smart Flood Sensor System (SFSS) using Arduino and GSM modules to detect and monitor whenever a flood comes and make people aware of the risk of flooding. This device will try to monitor the water level and notify the relevant authorities, and it will also notify the victim through their phone. This tool also has a sensor and a float switch that will help cut off the electricity, and as a result, the victim can avoid being electrocuted. In conclusion, this smart flood detection system has many benefits that can help users be aware of flood hazards and prevent them from being electrocuted.

articleTitle: The Students' Perspective on Content of Religious Moderation Website on E-Learning Character Education
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The rapid development of information and communication technology has encouraged various educational institutions to utilize E-learning systems to enhance the effectiveness and flexibility of learning. E-learning is increasingly recognized as one solution to educational challenges, both in developed and developing countries. E-learning allows learners to acquire knowledge without physically attending classes. This study is about students' opinions on Character Building learning through E-learning using 360-degree Panorama photos of places of worship and present an experience for students to look at photos to the left and right. The respondents of this study were 195 students, consisting of 75 women and 120 men who studied the Character Building course, specifically Character Building Religion. The results of this study are that more than 90% believe that the website material is easily accessible, and motivates to learn about other religions and increase understanding of other religions through 360-degree photo material of all places of worship. Student suggestions are the need for additional photo material of worship activities and photos of religious holidays as well as explanatory videos accompanied by subtitles. The website is suggested to have an English language option, as well as photos and videos about activities that reflect religious tolerance.

articleTitle: Influence of Internet Addiction, Browsing, and Hedonistic Lifestyle Customer to Product Impulsive Buying on Online Shops
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research project aims to provide valuable insights for academics and business professionals in designing and implementing online marketing strategies to increase sales turnover. The primary focus is to comprehend the consumer's impulsive purchasing behaviour by examining the factors that influence it, such as internet addiction, browsing habits, and hedonic lifestyle. This study employed a quantitative methodology, utilising structural equation modelling (SEM) and Likert scales for the purpose of measurement and analysis. The direct effect analysis demonstrated that variables such as internet addiction and browsing exert a substantial and favourable impact on a hedonic lifestyle. Furthermore, the act of browsing has a notable and favourable influence on impulsive purchasing behaviour. Nevertheless, the variables of internet addiction and hedonic lifestyle do not exert a substantial impact on impulsive buying behaviour of products in online stores, both within and outside Jakarta. This study offers novel perspectives on the dynamics of impulsive purchasing behaviour in online retail, elucidating the precise correlations among internet addiction, browsing habits, hedonic lifestyle, and impulsive buying of products on digital platforms.

articleTitle: Estimation of Eucalyptus DBH from UAV-LiDAR Data Utilizing Advanced Point Cloud Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The Diameter at Breast Height (DBH) measurements are essential for forest management and carbon absorption estimation in environmental challenges. Traditional DBH measurements require more precision and efficiency, especially in inaccessible forests. Existing methods, including manual measurement or remote sensing, struggle with precision in low-intensity point cloud areas. Our technique solves these limitations by analyzing the entire tree stem by the process, including convex hull construction and advanced noise reduction using real-world datasets. It has reduced the Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) to 0.020, or 92.25% improvement, and the bias has decreased to -0.008. These enhancements highlight the accuracy and reliability of our DBH estimation technique.

articleTitle: The Role of Electronic Platforms in the Educational Process: Calligrapher Platform as a Model
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Currently, electronic educational platforms play an extremely important role in providing free scientific content within the reach of community members. The Calligrapher platform is the first electronic platform for teaching Arabic calligraphy and Islamic decoration via the Internet, at the hands of an elite group of professional calligraphers, by providing several training courses. This study aims to shed light on the role of electronic platforms in the educational process, specifically the Al-Khattat electronic platform, and its effectiveness in the educational process. The importance of the study stems from it being the first study to address the definition of the effective and fruitful role achieved by the calligrapher platform in the educational process of Arabic calligraphy and Islamic decoration. The question in this context is the effective role it has achieved and the most prominent features of learning via digital platforms (the calligrapher platform is an example). The approach followed in this study is the case study approach, as it is consistent with the objectives and directions of the study. The study found that the electronic calligrapher platform is characterized by the multiplicity and diversity of training course tracks presented by senior specialized calligraphers and those with experience in Arabic calligraphy.

articleTitle: Implementation of Longest Common Subsequence Algorithm Using Thread Parallelization in Java
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This sequence alignment stands as a pivotal method in the realm of bioinformatics, meticulously employed to ascertain the degree of similarity between diverse sequences such as DNA, RNA, and amino acids. Among the myriad techniques utilized in tackling sequence alignment challenges, the Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) takes center stage. This paper delves into the realm of enhancing LCS efficiency through the implementation of thread parallelization. Drawing inspiration from the seminal work of Wagner and Fischer in 1974, both sequential and parallel techniques exhibit remarkable consistency in identifying the maximum length of LCS. However, this research goes a step further by introducing thread parallelization, which leverages multithreading, resource synchronization, and task decomposition within the domain of parallel programming. The meticulous integration of these advanced techniques results in a notable enhancement in terms of running time compared to the conventional iterative sequential approach. The experimentation and evaluation of both sequential and parallel approaches were conducted using Netbeans, a robust Integrated Development Environment (IDE) tailored for the Java Programming Language. The findings underscore the superior performance of the thread parallelization strategy, establishing its prowess in optimizing the execution time of LCS problem resolution.

articleTitle: Optimization Booking Management of Badminton Court in Jogja Badminton Community Using Mobile-Based FIFO Method
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The popularity of badminton in Indonesia, especially in Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta, shows a high interest in this sport. Badminton Jogja Community, as a court provider for it's members, faces challenges in court booking and queue management. Currently, the booking process is done through a WhatsApp group, which often results in a long and repetitive queue list, also creating schedule uncertainty as some members who have registered and does not attend. This research concern to address the challenges in badminton court booking management faced by Badminton Jogja Community. This research focuses on the application of FIFO (First In First Out) method in badminton court booking management with a cancellation system. The prototyping method was used to turn this idea into a practical application that allows users to register, cancel bookings, and manage court bookings efficiently. The final result of this research is an application that is able to overcome the problems of queue management and badminton court booking in this community, which is tested through application testing using black box testing. This research involves analyzing the needs of the booking management system and implementing the FIFO method so as to produce an effective solution for managing badminton court bookings.

articleTitle: Development E-Module Using Flip Book to Improve Learning Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Currently, many digital media support interactive & exciting learning. However, some schools have no titles or abstracts, including SMAN 7 Malang. Observation results show that learning resources are monotonous, so students struggle to understand the material. Students need interesting learning resources equipped with multimedia to support explanations of the material. Students need a digital economy module. This research aims to produce a digital economic module based on Flip PDF Professional on international trade material for high school students, and media and material experts will test its feasibility. Based on media expert research, the score obtained was 96.66%. Next, the module was tested by 99 class XI students at SMAN 7 Malang in two stages, initial and main stage trials. In the initial stage of trials, the score obtained was 89.77%. The results of the module assessment by media experts, material experts, and students are in a very good category, so it can be concluded that the module developed is suitable for use in high school economics learning on international trade material. the results of the pre-test and post-test assessments showed an increase with an N-Gain value of 0.755, which was in the high improvement category.

articleTitle: A Web-based Wedding Organizer Information System for Small and Medium Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Government-imposed social interaction restrictions and strict health protocol implementation during the pandemic have presented challenges for wedding organizer businesses, resulting in increased long-distance commercial communications and transactions between wedding organizer service providers and their customers. This research aims to create a website-based ordering application that allows one wedding organizer to manage data that is integrated with the database, making it easier for customers to order wedding packages. The application has three actors: administrator, manager, and customer. The methodology used in this research is descriptive and qualitative, with data collection techniques using field observations, interviews, and literature review. Rapid Application Development (RAD) as a software development methodology. The beta score obtained in this study is 89%, indicating that the score is in the “very feasible” category for use and that the user in that interface adheres to the eight golden rules of interface design. According to the study, a web-based system can increase communication between customers and administrative services, provide affordable custom services, allow online buying, and improve corporate productivity by offering automated documentation and reporting. This system information also provides an admin interface for authorized System Admin in managing the users, wedding packages, business transactions, and reporting system.

articleTitle: Tap & Stay: Streamlining Capsule Hotel Payments with Electronic Transactions
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Electronic payments have become a necessity to make payments securely. This trend is carried out in almost all types of industries. This study examines customer interest in using payment with electronic payment method when making payment for staying at Capsule Hotel. This research applies the TPB and ISS Model methods to make measurements. The population of this study was Capsule hotels. The study sample used random sampling with questionaires to collect data. This study was analyzed with SEMPLS. Based on our research for 4 month and Based on 400 questioners and 400 respondent, The results in this study found that attitude, subjective norm and service quality did not have an impact on trust variables. While other variables such as perceived behavioral control, system quality, and information quality affect customer trust variables. Trust variables also directly affect customer intention variables

articleTitle: Trust Bridge: The Mediating Power of Brand Trust in Regional Ambassador and Social Media Ads Influences on Loyalty
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The strategy of using brand ambassadors has proven itself to be an effective way to increase consumer purchases. With the presence of a brand ambassador who can connect with the audience up close and personal, consumers feel more connected to the brand. Therefore, the objective of this research is to examine how the utilization of brand ambassadors and social media ads affects brand loyalty in users of e-commerce located in Bekasi City, with brand trust as a mediating variable. This research was carried out using quantitative methods, involving 200 respondents who were selected using the convenience sampling method. These results offer a more profound insight into how brand loyalty can be influenced by brand ambassadors and social media ads, specifically by enhancing brand trust. There is customer loyalty that does not affect regional brand ambassadors and social media advertising, so in this case it is important for company to improve and develop communication and interaction between ambassadors and customers, as well as developing more interesting and informative advertising.

articleTitle: FIFO Method Implementation on Agricultural Commodities Order Management
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: PT Ince Jaya Mandiri (Injama) faces problems in the order fulfillment process due to errors and delays in creating the necessary documents, as well as confusion in tracking the status of orders because there is no method used in the order fulfillment process. The main objective of this research is to improve the order fulfillment process. Thus, an appropriate order fulfillment method is needed so that the process can run more structurally and efficiently. To help the order fulfillment process, the First In First Out (FIFO) method is used. The proposed order fulfillment process improvement is a process carried out using an order fulfillment application developed using prototyping. Prototyping consists of several stages, including Communication, Quick Plan and Modeling Quick Design, Construction of Prototype, and Development Delivery & Feedback. Black Box Testing results show that 86% of the tested functions can be accepted by the user. The results exceeded the target by 6% of the minimum target of 80%. Thus, the application of the FIFO method can effectively help the daily order fulfillment process with large quantities and become a solution to errors and delays in document preparation and confusion in tracking the status of orders.

articleTitle: Student Dropout Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Student dropout is a critical challenge for universities worldwide. To address this concern, Bangkok University implemented additional caring, complemented by a machine learning model developed to predict freshman dropout probability. This research investigates the factors contributing to student dropout, including demographic characteristics, academic performance, and financial status. Utilizing data from the 2021st academic year, we perform a comparative analysis of multiple classifier algorithms to identify the most effective model for dropout prediction. The Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) algorithm emerges as the top performer based on its precision-recall curve (AUC-PR) score, highlighting the significance of features like RegS2 (second semester registration status) and CumCredit_S1 (median first-semester credits earned). The combined oversampling and undersampling technique are used to address this imbalance and improve the performance of the XGBoost algorithm with fine-tuned parameters. To implementation on 2022nd students, tuned classifier achieve precision up to 84.96% and recall up to 86.84%. It can assist advisers to identify at-risk students from many variables, not only GPA.

articleTitle: The Use of Video-Based Learning to Improve Chinese Grammar Ability
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of using video-based learning to improve Mandarin grammar skills. Traditional learning methods are often considered less interesting and less effective in teaching Chinese grammar. Therefore, this research proposes the integration of video-based learning technology as an alternative approach. This study involved 36 students using video-based learning and a collective 24-item testing survey. The results of the analysis showed a significant increase in Mandarin grammar skills in the group that used video-based learning. The implications of these findings support the use of video technology in language learning contexts, especially to improve understanding and mastery of Mandarin grammar. This study contributes to further understanding of the role of technology in improving foreign language grammar skills.

articleTitle: Chineseway Apps as Chinese Vocabulary Learning Tools
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The Chineseway application is an effective tool for learning basic Mandarin vocabulary. This research explores user perspectives on its design and efficacy in language learning. The application uses flashcards and mnemonic techniques to enhance memory recall. Through surveys and interviews, users’ feedback reveals the application's potential in engaging learners and delivering practical outcomes. The well-designed interface and mnemonic approach create an interactive learning experience. The study confirms the efficacy of the flashcard-based learning method, improving vocabulary retention. The mnemonic technique aids users in recalling learned vocabulary, further enhancing the learning process. The Chinese Way apps were applied to 24 students, all of whom were very enthusiastic when doing the exercises on Chineseway and all their answers were correct. Overall, this research substantiates the Chineseway apps as a valuable tool for Mandarin language acquisition. Incorporating user feedback will enhance its effectiveness and user satisfaction, showcasing the power of innovative learning media in language acquisition. A suggestion for future research is to expand the vocabulary in Chinese Apps according to the topics studied in textbooks. Apart from that, the number of respondents also increased.

articleTitle: Technology on Face Recognition in the Hospitality Industry: How Do Employees Perceived This Technology?
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Face recognition is a technological invention that is rapidly being used in a variety of fields, including employee attendance and access control. The study employs the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) framework to investigate how perceived ease of use and perceived usefulness of technology influence employee attitudes and usage intentions. This study focuses on facial recognition as a technique for influencing employee attitudes and behavior in reaction to changes induced by external sources. This study employed a purposive sample methodology at five-star hotels and food and beverage businesses and the SEMPLS analysis method. It is believed that the findings of this study will provide additional insight into the elements that influence people's intentions to utilize facial recognition technology in the workplace, as well as advice for businesses to promote the use of this technology more successfully. According to research findings, using facial recognition with TAM demonstrates that perceived ease of use represents employee attitudes toward use, resulting in positive and significant behavioral intentions. This study's practical results and theoretical contributions will aid in developing and applying facial recognition technologies in workplace human resource management.

articleTitle: Digital Activism for Beginners; Student Digital Activism Content Analysis on Bemfisipui and Bemkmunnes Compared to Narasinewsroom on Instagram
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The use of social media on Instagram supports student movements to join national political discourse. Students could gather and influence public opinion through their posts on contemporary issues. This study aims to explore @bemfisipui, @bemkmunnes digital activism activity and compare it to professional media @narasinewsroom. Visual rhetoric of Seliger (2014) is used to analyze 22.635 posts of @bemfisipui @bemkmunnes and @narasinewsroom. Both student council Bemfisipui and Bemkmunnes are actively posting and discussing current political situation. However, our research shows that Indonesian student councils Bemfisipui and Bemkmunnes are less active compared to professional media Narasinewsroom. Both student movements and Narasi use symbols (informing), communicators (activating), and image types (explaining) to convey their visual messages. These three accounts discuss political issues through the same public figure. Namely, the Chief Justice of the Constitutional Anwar, President Joko Widodo, and the Vice President CandidateGibran Rakabuming Raka.

articleTitle: The Reputation Quotient: Evaluating the Impact of Chatbots on the Online Image of Star-Rated Hotels
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The advancement of information and communication technologies has encouraged luxury hotels to embrace service delivery innovations, with chatbots emerging as a crucial technical achievement. The competitive integration of chatbots has been encountered in the Indonesian Star-rated Hotels market. Despite varying levels of acceptance, its features include sales, front office, reservations, and food and beverages, demonstrating the industry's recognition of chatbot technology as a competitive demand. This quantitative study focuses on 3, 4, and 5-star hotels in Jakarta that use chatbots in the Reservation and Concierge Section. This study using random sampling technique to target customers who use chatbot services. SEMPLS studies of survey data intends to explicate the influence of chatbots on star-rated hotels, providing insights into chatbot effectiveness in improving customer service and changing hotel reputation. The result showed that Chatbots services and Customer Satisfaction influencing Star-Rated Hotel Reputation.

articleTitle: The Impact of Digital Reviews Toward Purchase Intention: Influencer Versus Customer
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Electronic word-of-mouth has become a powerful way to promote any brands, products, or service because people are more likely to trust their peers' opinions than advertisers. The aim of the research is to determine the impact of electronic word of mouth from influencer and customer reviews on e-commerce platforms towards purchase intention of Scarlett Whitening products. Scarlett Whitening has achieved success as a top skin care brand with total sales reaching Rp.78.3 billion in the first half of 2022. The research method is using quantitative approach, involving the distribution of questionnaires to a sample of 100 respondents with 72% female and 28% male who are the followers of Scarlett Whitening on Instagram, have observed reviews of Scarlett Whitening conducted by influencer, as well as by customer on e-commerce platforms. The results of the study indicate that there is a positive influence between influencer marketing (24.8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) and customer reviews (69,4%) on purchase intention. In addition, reviews from customers on e-commerce have a bigger impact on purchase intention compared to influencer marketing. Therefore, companies are advised to monitor reviews on e-commerce more closely. Especially for e-commerce accounts that are handled by resellers that represent not only the product, but also the service quality.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network for Cataract Clasification Using Primary Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Cataracts are the main factor causing blindness in Indonesia. Traditional diagnostic methods involving clinical examination by an ophthalmologist using a slit-lamp and visual tests have many challenges such as limited resources, time, and medical expertise may not be available in all locations, especially in less developed areas. Utilizing medical image technology is a wise choice because it allows early detection and monitoring of the development of this cataract disease Technology is needed to identify medical images that have valuable information so that early detection or monitoring of cataract development can be carried out. CNN as a part of deep learning has the ability to perform automatic feature extraction so that it can identify eye images. A CNN model for recognizing cataracts in eye images taken directly from Bhayangkara Hospital in Denpasar Bali has been developed in this research. The model developed is equipped with a dropout layer technique to prevent overfitting. The test results show that the CNN developed in this research produces very good performance with an average accuracy level of 92% on public dataset images, and 94% on primary dataset images. Tested using the primary dataset and public dataset, this CNN model shows very good performance because it can correctly identify an average of 94% of eye images in the primary dataset, and 92% of eye images in the public dataset..

articleTitle: The Influences of Service Experience, Technology Acceptance and Digital Satisfaction on Digital Loyalty, Case Study of Netflix Subscribers in Bangkok
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This quantitative research aimed to analyze the impact of service experience, technology acceptance (TAM), and digital satisfaction on digital loyalty among Netflix subscribers in Bangkok. The data was collected through an online questionnaire from 543 Netflix subscribers residing in Bangkok and the surrounding areas of Thailand. The result shows that service experience characteristics have a favorable direct influence on their satisfaction, followed by technology acceptance (TAM) factor. Additionally, the factor of satisfaction had a direct positive impact on digital loyalty.

articleTitle: Enhancing Operational Efficiency in Energy Monitoring and Control: A Fuzzy Logic Approach at PT. Akebono Brake Astra Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: PT Akebono Brake Astra Indonesia faces energy efficiency challenges due to the use of 68 AC units in various rooms. The main issue is inefficient energy management, exacerbated by employee negligence in turning off the air conditioners when unnecessary. This leads to manual checks consuming high man-hours. Initial observations highlight the need for integrated systems to monitor and control energy usage. To address this, a prototype using fuzzy logic for integrated energy monitoring and control is developed. The fuzzy logic approach is chosen for its suitability in decision-making amid uncertainty and in machine control with multiple input variables. The study aims to analyze the application of fuzzy logic at PT Akebono Brake Astra Indonesia. The process involves in-depth communication to understand system requirements, followed by prototype design for operational clarity. The results indicate that fuzzy logic is effective, reducing total AC energy control time by 108 minutes. This method enhances process efficiency in manufacturing operations, aligning with the concept of a sustainable industry.

articleTitle: Power of Short Video Advertising: Analyzing the Purchase Behavior of Different Generations Basis for Crafting a Video Advertisement
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research employed a simple random sampling method to gather insights from different generations, spanning from baby boomers to generation Z, encompassing a total of 385 respondents in Metro Manila. The study focused on purchase behavior, specifically the key elements of creating impactful short video advertisements, including duration, influencers, editing, color, sound, and content. A survey questionnaire was used and tested for validity with a Cronbach alpha of 0.894. Kruskal-Wallis's test was used to establish the relationship between variables. When it comes to visual representation-duration, editing, and content are significant to the purchase behavior of the respondents and when it comes to level of importance in crafting a short video advertisement-only influencers and content had a significant difference. The result of this study can be a basis in improving the marketing strategy, specifically in creating video advertisements for companies.

articleTitle: Systematic Review of Differentiated Instruction Implementation in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research is a systematic literature review exploring the implementations of Differentiated Instruction (DI) in higher education. Differentiated Instruction is a pedagogical approach and focus that aims to tailor teaching approaches and content delivery to the varied learning needs of students. The present study tries to provide an in-detail review of the existing literature on the topic of DI in higher education with specific references to its aims, methods, results, implications or repercussions for educationalists as well as students. A total of 35 relevant studies were found useful for this purpose after making a systematic search of the academic databases in the years from 2012 to 2023. The findings indicate that DI as an instructional practice delivered in the higher education is gradually gaining popularity in improving the engagement, achievement, and retention of learners.

articleTitle: Automated Data Pipeline for Product Lead Time Analysis by using Alteryx Designer and Qlik Sense
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This work covers the implementation of a transformative project within the Process Innovation department, focusing on the conversion of Quality data into Business data utilization. The project primarily involved the transition from manual to automated processes and the development of a dashboard to mitigate process interruptions. The report emphasizes the data preparation and visualization phases, The result of the project includes the development and implementation, resulting in a 6-hour and 30-minute reduction in data processing time, equivalent to approximately 96.40% improvement compared to the previous method. Additionally, the report addresses encountered challenges, their resolutions, and insights gained, enriching the understanding of project implementation dynamics.

articleTitle: An Evaluation: RSA Factorization Acquired Euler Totient Through Mathematical Formulas
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In our previous paper, we emphasized the importance for organizers of RSA key pair generators to carefully consider multiple factors. This is due to the identification of specific risks associated with potential attacks, where effective and efficient RSA factorization plays a crucial role as mentioned [16]–[19]. The complexity of RSA (n) factorization depends on both the algorithm employed and the tools utilized for swift and accurate calculations [10]–[12]. These tools include the prime database method, which attempts factorization based on available prime experiments, and another method involving quadratic equations involving the Pythagorean [24], [25], as well as Euler Totient, capable of performing calculations for RSA factorization [13]–[15]. In our research, we introduce an alternative method for factoring RSA n through the mathematical formula to obtain Euler Totient values <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\phi(n)\ \equiv \mathrm{t}$</tex>. These values are then utilized in the factorization process by gt mod n using the linear programming method g = g + 1. Subsequently, we assess the success rate of this methodology with the hope of identifying the latest results and exploring new opportunities for further research.

articleTitle: The Impact of Online Travel Agents and Offline Travel Agents on Hotel Industry Revenue
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This article delves into the impact of Online Travel Agents (OTAs) and Offline Travel Agents on hotel revenue within the hospitality industry. The research aims to comprehensively discuss and analyze the influence of these entities on the financial performance of hotels. Employing a quantitative approach, the study involved 150 selected respondents chosen through random sampling. The data collected were then subjected to multiple regression analysis to uncover insights into the relationship between revenue and both Online and Offline Travel Agents. The results indicate a positive influence of revenue on both types of travel agents, underscoring the significance of financial performance in shaping collaborative dynamics between hotels and travel agencies. This research contributes valuable insights to industry practitioners and stakeholders, shedding light on the pivotal role of revenue in optimizing partnerships and strategies with travel agents.

articleTitle: Machine-Learned Defense Mechanism Against Phishing URL Exploitation for User Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Phishing is a cyberattack where attackers attempt to deceive individuals or organizations into providing sensitive information such as passwords, credit card numbers, or personal data. URL phishing is one of the phishing attack methods where attackers create fake URLs that mimic legitimate ones, tricking users into clicking and potentially compromising their sensitive information. To defend against URL phishing, traditional methods like blacklists and whitelists are effective in detecting malicious URLs but struggle with identifying new ones. Therefore, machine learning is now widely used. Features are an important component. There are three common types of features that can be extracted from URLs: Lexical-based, Content-based, and Network-based features. Our purpose is to find out which types of features can enhance the effectiveness and accuracy of machine learning in detecting malicious URLs. In this paper, we focus on comparing the effectiveness between two feature groups: lexical-based and content-based, which involve analysis of textual properties features. We use Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) to select 10 features from each group, both lexical-based and content-based. Then we apply a random forest model to the classification task. The results shown that the 10 features selected from the content-based features can achieve the highest accuracy of 97%.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of Thermal Performance of Windows with External Shading Slats for Air-Conditioned Buildings in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The thermal performance of a glazed window equipped with external multiple slats was investigated for which it was used as a façade of air-conditioned buildings in a tropical climate. Experiments were carried out to measure the transmitted solar radiation, window surface temperature, and longwave heat gain at different slat angles. Using the measured data, empirical models were proposed for calculating the solar transmission of the slats and of the whole window system as a function of the slat angle. In the study, the proposed model coupled with the overall thermal transfer value (OTTV) formula of Thailand's building energy code (BEC) was demonstrated for determining the annual average heat gain through the window with the slats. The results showed that by substantially reducing the incident solar radiation on the window when the beam radiation was fully shaded, the window with the slats had 70-80% less heat gain than the window without shading.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Crossover Network Using O′Shea′s Transformation via URC
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This paper describes method of synthesis two-way cross-over network, namely low-pass filter and high-pass filter. Firstly, we introduce synthesis method of obtain all-pass filter. We introduce O′Shea′s transformation <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\bm{P}}( {\bm{s}} ) = {\bm{cosh}}\sqrt {{\bm{SRC}}}$</tex> and Wyndrum′s transformation <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\bm{W}}( {\bm{s}} ){\bm{\ }} = {\bm{\ tanh}}\sqrt {{\bm{SRC}}}$</tex> via uniformly distributed RC (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\overline {{\bm{URC}}}$</tex>) network. After obtaining a desired all-pass filter, as an elementary process. We construct low-pass filter and high-pass filter by means of all-pass filter basis. Simulation results MATLAB are carried out and stability are also investigated.

articleTitle: The Implementation of Moves in Email Genre Model for Complaint Letter: The Case Study of Thai EFL Writing
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This exploratory study aimed at finding the application of the Email Genre Model developed by Zsubrinszky to teach business correspondence with Thai undergraduate learners. The main purpose is to identify the four main moves in writing business complaint letter. The random convenient sampling method was employed. The number of participants was 35 in an EFL classroom at the private educational institute. For the method of data collection, the quantitative analysis was used as the main method to collect the data both in student's pieces of writing and their perception toward this Genre model. The Descriptive frequency applied to show the tendency of students‘ perception. The findings included the learner's perception, language structures, writing style and vocabulary used in the student's writings. It can be concluded that the learners were aware of the politeness in writing letters. Nevertheless, most of the students’ writing style were at the moderate level of politeness and relatively straight forward way of writing. For the learner's perception, more than 80% of the learners had positive attitude. From these findings, the Zsubrinszky's Email Genre Model could be implied to the classroom practice as an alternative way of the pedagogical implication for teaching business correspondence in EFL classrooms.

articleTitle: The Impact of Language Expressions and Visual Exploration on Neurodivergent Artist Quotes in Educational Setting
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In recent years, neurodiversity has gained popularity among those proponents of people's inclusion, dignity, and rights. Demonstrations and images help them learn more effectively. Give written instructions, visual clues, and brief spoken instructions when feasible. Furthermore, the researchers included seventeen student populations, eleven officers and staff, and twelve lecturer populations. For two days in a row, they attended the interactive quotation display by neurodivergent artists, and in response, they contributed drawings that reflected their interpretations of the quotes. An interview served as the second method of gathering data. The researchers also conducted a structured interview with four students, four officers, and three lecturers acting as spokespeople. Quotes from the works of Neurodivergent Artists such as Nintendo, Love, Amsterdam, Suzanne, Kacamata (Glasses), Teman (Friends), Mudik (Homecoming), Menjahit (Sewing), and Iggle can be found in the Interactive Installation activity. Using a mixed-methods approach, the researchers collected and examined the data (Creswell, 2014). It is an approach that blends qualitative and quantitative research techniques. According to the findings, the Amsterdam quote is liked by lecturers, staff, and students alike. In addition, the Love quote sparks curiosity in both students and instructors, indicating a mutual admiration for its meaning.

articleTitle: Mixed-Features-Based Deep Learning Approach for Sign Language Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Sign language classification is a challenging task due to the complexity and diversity of sign gestures, and hand shapes. This paper presents deep learning approach for sign language classification using a mixed-features method. Two distinct datasets derived from a common source, i.e., a conventional image and a transformed histogram, are used for the input of deep learning model. The image dataset serves as input for a convolutional neural network (CNN) model, capturing spatial dependencies and features, while the histogram dataset is adapted for input to a long short-term memory (LSTM) model, emphasizing temporal aspects of hand gestures. This integration not only enables a comprehensive analysis of both spatial and temporal characteristics but also facilitates a reduction in the overall model size. The experimental results demonstrate notable improvements in efficiency metrics. The proposed method can achieve a reduction in model size, alleviating resource-intensive computational requirements. Furthermore, the need for extensive data augmentation is eliminated, streamlining the training process. Consequently, the proposed approach significantly enhances the overall efficiency of the sign language classification system.

articleTitle: The Enhanced MPPT Using Slope Detection Algorithm for PV System Under Partial Shading and Low Irradiation Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) technology, being a prominent renewable energy source primarily due to its environmentally friendly operation and versatile installation options. To improve the efficiency of photovoltaic (PV) systems, it is essential to take into account the impact of weather conditions. Irradiation and temperature are two primary parameters influencing PV-generated power, both of which vary depending on the location where the PV system is installed. Consequently, the issue of irradiation mismatch may arise, posing challenges for the PV system in achieving its maximum potential power generation. This paper presents the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm that can operates under partial shading and low irradiation conditions. The algorithm operates with a concept of searching the highest mountain's peak point. Case studies using the irradiation dataset from the Department of Alternative Energy Development and Efficiency are input to evaluate the performance of the proposed method under different weather conditions. Graphical and numerical results show the effectiveness of the algorithm, with the searching time under 1.36 seconds and the accuracy at 99.55%.

articleTitle: The Role of Technological Assistance: Assessing Service Quality in Self-Service Kiosk
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Self-Service technology developed purchase method in Fast-Food restaurant, example at Mc'Donald Fast-Food Restaurant. With the Self-Service Kiosk at Mc'Donalds, consumers feel easier or faster to order food they preferred. This research aims to investigating how customer intention to reuse Self-service Kiosk to order food. The antecedents such as service quality, perceived value and Customer experience through Customer satisfaction. This research is a quantitative approach. This research was conducted using 270 selected respondents in convenient sampling method. This study analyzed by structural equation model (SEM) analysis technique. The result on this study was four hypotheses were accepted, and three hypotheses were rejected.

articleTitle: The Impact of Robotic, Artificial Intelligence, and Service Automation Adoption on Job Security Perception and Work Performance in Hospitality Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study explores the impact of RAISA on job security and performance in the hospitality industry, focusing on perspectives from students and employees. The hospitality sector has evolved with intelligent technology integration, improving customer experiences. Service robots, while providing benefits like service consistency and perceived privacy, pose challenges such as the risk of eroding traditional hospitality concepts and the need for human-like interactions. This study aims to investigate RAISA's impact on job security and performance in the hospitality industry. Methodologically, the study employed a quantitative approach, collecting data from Greater Jakarta's hotel industry employees through a survey distributed via various communication channels. Smart PLS was utilized for its suitability in handling a small sample size and assessing the validity of research samples with high degrees of multiple correlations. In conclusion, this study reveals a substantial and statistically significant correlation between RAISA awareness, job insecurity, and job performance in the hospitality industry. While shedding light on these dynamics, the research acknowledges its limitations and suggests avenues for future studies with a larger and more diverse participant pool beyond Greater Jakarta and the hospitality sector.

articleTitle: The Impact of Service Robots on Guest Satisfaction in Generation Z
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The adoption of service robots has been increased, particularly in the hospitality industry. This study aimed to examine the influence of service robots on guest satisfaction, focusing on Generation Z. This study employed an online questionnaire to gather data from Generation Z residing in Jakarta. The poll was disseminated between October 2023 and December 2023. The data was collected using convenience sampling as the methodology. The survey was published on several social media platforms. A total of 210 participants took part in this study, the analysis technique method was SEM (structural equation modelling), and the data was processed with SmartPLS. Furthermore, this study demonstrated that the presence of a service robot positively influences the level of guest satisfaction. The outcome of this research is anticipated to provide valuable understanding of service robots, particularly for hotels located in Jakarta.

articleTitle: Implementation of Augmented Reality Technology on Solar System Materials in the Learning of Sciences at An-Nahl Integrated Islamic Elementary School
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The use of Augmented Reality technology in learning media provides a visualization of 3D objects to students, facilitating their understanding of the material. One of the challenges faced by SDIT AN-NAHL is ensuring that students comprehend the taught material through effective multiple communication. To address this challenge, SDIT AN-NAHL decided to implement Augmented Reality technology using the Unity 3D platform and Vuforia library. This research aims to implement Augmented Reality technology using the Unity 3D platform in Natural Science learning, specifically focusing on the solar system, and to assess the improvement in students learning outcomes after the implementation of Augmented Reality media in the solar system material in IPA lessons at the Elementary School. The result of this research is the Tata Surya AR application. In all evaluations conducted on students, the questionnaire results reflect the positive adoption and effectiveness of AR technology in enhancing the experience and learning outcomes of students in the context of solar system learning. Based on the questionnaire results from the overall evaluation conducted on teachers, it can be concluded that most teachers feel that the use of Augmented Reality technology contributes positively to student learning.

articleTitle: Brand Loyalty & Brand Awareness Through Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Technological developments are currently growing rapidly in terms of selling and purchasing products via social media platforms. The social media that are mostly used to market products are TikTok, Shopee, Instagram, Tokopedia, and Lazada. These five social media are used by sellers to market their products through social media marketing activities (SMM - Social Media Marketing), product descriptions (trendiness), entertainment, and distributing uploaded videos (WOM - Word of Mouth). This will attract customers' interest in interacting with sellers regarding the products being marketed. Social media is closely connected to customers, especially in terms of marketing, creating value for businesses. In this research we proposed a conceptual model, the perceived social media marketing (SMM) activities can be measured as a communication tool to stimulate brand loyalty and brand awareness in consumer behavior. The result shows that the use of social media with trendiness as a variable is strong for all variables, suggesting that social media usage is significantly influenced by trends in a particular society due to the prevailing trends in the community.

articleTitle: Analysis of Pavement Deterioration with Pavement Performance Indicators for Yangon-Mandalay Expressway
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Pavement Condition Index (PCI) and International Roughness Index (IRI) are the most popular pavement performance indices to evaluate the pavement quality. Optimum pavement maintenance strategy can be determined based on these data. The main aim of this research is to investigate the effect of pavement distress on PCI and IRI to develop pavement performance model with significant types of pavement distresses for Yangon-Mandalay Expressway (YME). Types of distresses with different severity levels for YME were collected according to American Society for Testing and Materials ASTM D6433-18 by practical survey with the aid of technical equipment to calculate PCI values. Pavement surface roughness of IRI values were measured with RoadLab Pro software for both ways of Yangon-Mandalay Expressway. The data included a total of 130 sample units including 66 and 64 sample units for concrete and Asphalt Concrete (AC) overlay pavement respectively. PCI and IRI models were developed using Multiple Linear Regression analysis (MLR). According to the four regression models, potholes, joint reflection cracking, patching and weathering are the most common types of AC overlay distresses and durability crack, faulting, joint seal, lane and shoulder drop off, linear cracking, patching, scaling, shrinkage are the most occurrence distresses of concrete pavement.

articleTitle: A Bi-LSTM Regression-Aided Estimation Technique for Time-Varying Multiple DoAs
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Motivated by mmWave applications in beyond 5th generation communication systems, direction of arrival (DoA) estimation techniques have re-attracted attention due to the line-of-sight propagation property of mmWave signals. Conventional DoA estimation algorithms require statistical signal models, which are not always available in practice. In addition, the conventional Root-MUISC can suffer from mean squared error (MSE) deterioration seriously in practical scenarios having multiple DoA parameters that change independently over time. Therefore, recently, supervised learning-based DoA estimation algorithms using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) have attracted attention. Specifically, a conventional DoA classification method using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks can improve the aforementioned problems. However, it is difficult to improve MSE performance further than the resolution assumed in the classifier due to a finite number of classes. As a solution to these problems, this paper proposes a bi-directional LSTM regression-aided DoA estimation technique that obtains estimates by solving a regression problem from features captured in both the forward and backward directions of the observed sequence. Simulation results verify that, in a low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) regime, the Bi-LSTM regression achieves a remarkable NMSE gain > 10 dB at normalized MSE = 1 over the Root-MUSIC and conventional Classification-CNN in a practical scenario.

articleTitle: Retro Reflectivity Measurement of Pavement Marking by Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Pavement marking is an essential element of traffic operation and road safety. Pavement markings are beneficial because they provide information to drivers about road alignment and conditions ahead. The quality of pavement markings at nighttime is measured by their retro-reflectivity value. This study aims to investigate a technique to predict the retro-reflectivity value of pavement markings using image processing. A relationship between brightness value and retro-reflectivity value will be utilized to make predictions. In this study, computer coding was developed to analyze pictures of pavement markings at night to identify the brightness of markings 15 meters away from a testing vehicle. This involved selecting different ranges of thermoplastic pavement marking retro-reflectivity values by choosing testing sites at King Mongkut's University of Technology Thonburi. The analysis employed an exponential function to create a retro-reflectivity prediction model based on the relationship between brightness value and retro-reflectivity value.

articleTitle: Monozukuri Personnel Development and Operational Performance: The Mediating Role of Kaizen Event
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The objective of this study was to determine the relationship monozukuri personnel development, kaizen event and operational performance using structural equation modeling (SEM). The samples were selected from the list of Japanese investments in the Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC) in Thailand. The number of respondents was 238. An SEM technique was used for the study. To test the reliability and validity of the instrument, a confirmatory factor analysis was conducted to test the factor loading, composite reliability, average variance extracted, Cronbach's alpha, validity, and goodness of fit. The results indicate that the theoretical model and empirical data have a good fit of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\chi 2=139.57, \text{df}=53, \chi 2/$</tex> df=2.633, p-value =0.00, CFI=0.97, GFI=0.96, AGFI=0.94, RMR=0.01, RMSEA=0.05. The results show that Monozukuri HRD is directly and strongly related to Kaizen events and operational performance. And the effect of monozukuri HRD on operational performance increased with the mediation of kaizen event. Thus, this study has shown that the empirical test results prove that monozukuri human resource development and kaizen event improved operational performance for the automotive, steel and electronics industries that Japanese investment in the Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC) in Thailand.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis on Music Streaming Platform Using User Experience Questionnaire and PACMAD Method on Gen Z
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Technological advancements have profoundly reshaped the music industry, propelling it into the digital age where music is now predominantly consumed through online streaming platforms. The two most prominent online streaming platforms today are Apple Music and Spotify.
