Therefore, this study aims to compare User Experience (UE) using both quantitative analysis, employing the User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ), and qualitative evaluation, utilizing the Practical and Creative Multi-Attribute Design (PACMAD) method for the Generation Z demographic. Technological advances have changed the music industry significantly, pushing it into a digital era where music is now largely consumed through online streaming platforms. The two most prominent online streaming platforms today are Apple Music and Spotify. Therefore, this research aims to compare User Experience (UE) using quantitative analysis, using the User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ), and qualitative evaluation, using the Practical and Creative Multi-Attribute Design (PACMAD) method for Generation Z demographics. The usability test of both Apple Music and Spotify demonstrates a relative similarity, with Spotify holding an edge in most aspects, and according to the findings of the UEQ, Spotify outperformed Apple Music in terms of attractiveness, clarity, efficiency, engagement, and innovation.

articleTitle: Construction of a Remote Laser Processing System Combined with Robot Teaching Using AR
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: As Japan's working population declines, there is an urgent need to develop human resources capable of utilizing digital technology in various fields in order to improve productivity. NIT, Anan College has four microfabrication lasers with different characteristics. This provides a unique laser processing environment that other colleges do not have. In addition, Anan College was one of the first to introduce cooperative robots for educational use. Correspondingly, we are using Augmented Reality technology for teaching cooperative robots to improve efficiency, and building a system that enables the secure use of valuable laser processing machines through remote control.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy of Bali Lontar Digitization Using the Jaro Winkler Distance Method
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)

authors.preferredName: I Putu Agus Eka Darma Udayana

abstract: Lontar is one of Bali's cultural heritages that must be preserved. In recent years, the lontar conservation team from Gianyar Regency found that many lontar collections owned by residents were damaged. This damage is caused by various factors, one of which is the lack of knowledge of residents in caring for Lontar. Not only residents' collections but some damaged collections were also found in the Bali Provincial Cultural Office. As a solution, this research develops a lontar digitization system that can convert Latin text into Balinese script using the Jaro Winkler Distance method. The result of the development of this lontar digitization system is that the system can produce output that has content that is close to the original lontar. Of the 10 sheets tested, an accuracy rate of 92.7% was obtained. In media expert testing by assessed the writing structure by Balinese script rules, which obtained an accuracy rate of 93.6%. In the accuracy test involving the spelling checker process using the Jaro Winkler distance method, the accuracy was 93.8%.

articleTitle: Optimizing CO2 Emission Predictions through an Ensemble Approach: Utilizing XGBRegressor, RandomForestRegressor, and DecisionTreeRegressor Models
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research presents a new approach to classification optimization using an ensemble approach. With the urgent need for accurate CO2 emission predictions due to global climate problems, traditional prediction models sometimes fail regarding precision and reliability. This study attempts to bridge this gap by using an ensemble approach, which combines the strengths of three well-known models: XGBRegressor, RandomForestRegressor, and DecisionTreeRegressor. This research also uses ensemble methods to improve the performance of these three models. Our results show a significant improvement in prediction accuracy with the ensemble model compared to the individual model output; in 2019, the RMSE was recorded at 14.370, with a Final Score of 14.414. In 2020, the RMSE value increased to 19.615 with a final score of 19.712. In 2021, the RMSE reached 18.470 with a Final Score of 18.595. This research contributes to the growing literature supporting ensemble methodology and emphasizes optimizing CO2 predictions for policymaking, environmental monitoring, and sustainable industrial practices.

articleTitle: Digital Marketing, Brand Awareness and Customer Relationship Management on Repurchase Intention in E-Commerce Marketplace
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The development of technology and information has changed consumer behavior. Hence, the marketing strategy challenge lies in how effectively it can increase awareness, conversion, and repurchase behavior as the determinants of e-commerce business sustainability. This study explores the influence of digital marketing, brand awareness, and customer relationship management on repurchase intention, with brand trust mediating variables in the e-commerce marketplace. The research analysis tool is SmartPLS 3.0, which shows an influence between digital marketing, customer relationship marketing, and brand trust on repurchase intention. Hence, digital marketing, customer relationship management, and brand awareness must be considered by digital marketers in the e-commerce marketplace to increase repurchase intention. The research is expected to provide managerial implications in the form of contributions to the e-commerce marketplace regarding how effectively digital marketing can reach consumers and inform them about new products, offers, discounts, or promotions that increase conversion rates in the e-commerce marketplace.

articleTitle: Identify Assessment Indicators in Online Learning to Increase Student Performance Using Neural Network Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The main point of predicting student performance is to identify students at-risk as early as possible to enable instructors to implement educational interventions and facilitate student achievement. In this study, we have used Neural Network aproach to identify assement indicator in Online Learning. The dataset used is Distance Learning Student Value Data extracted through Learning Management Systems The highest accuracy value obtained was 99.61% with a precision value of 99.37%, a recall of 98.87% and a relatively low RMSE value of 5.5%. The best accuracy results from the training data distribution ratio of 70% and 30%, while the proposed number of hidden layers is 2 hidden layers with the number of neurons in each layer H1(Hidden layer 1) and H2(Hidden layer 2) is 12. And the value of learning rate is 0.04. This study contributes to the selection of Neural Network architectures in determining student performance predictions. In addition, it has an impact on the analysis of which variables affect student passing grades. So that it can be a reference in determining content improvements and further learning models in Online Learning.

articleTitle: Human Resource Information System Design PT Fidac Inovasi Teknologi
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The development of information technology has greatly facilitated work, especially for fintech companies in facing the current and future era. The absence of a system that helps manage data is a problem in making reports because the business processes carried out are not computerized or are still manual, using paper forms for applying for leave and overtime. Employees do not know the progress of the application that has been submitted, how much leave the employee is entitled to and HRD finds it difficult to control employees because they are not effective and efficient. This research aims to develop a Human Resources Information System at PT Fidac Innovation Technology using the Scrum method and using the CodeIgniter (PHP) framework. User requirements data was obtained through interviews with employees and HR staff. The result achieved is the existence of a Human Resources data management system that can facilitate and assist existing business operational processes.

articleTitle: Optimal Crop Spacing for Vertical Irrigation PFAL
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Space utilization is a crucial factor in the operating efficiency of plant factory with artificial lighting (PFAL). The optimal farming pattern in vertical irrigation PFAL is proposed based on the assumption that crop canopies have circular shape and identical size across the growing area. The objective is to minimize the unoccupied areas so that the number of plant density is optimized at the time of harvesting. Obtained results show that the optimal number of empty channels between crops does not necessarily increase along with the radius of crop canopy. The optimal number of crops at different sizes of radius (r) and number of empty channels between crops (x) is suggested.

articleTitle: A Study on the Thresholding Method for Through-Thickness Porosity in Microscopic Image of CFRP
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: One of the significant factors of carbon fiber reinforced plastics (CFRPs) that impact the mechanical properties is the porosity. Several methods of porosity analysis have been reported, such as digital image processing. One interesting image processing technique is thresholding, which is based on segmentation by adjusting the threshold level of images. In this work, the through-thickness cross-section microscopic images of CFRP are measured by the content of the composition, i.e., void, fiber, and matrix, by thresholding process. A range of threshold levels is varied by brightness to identify each composition. At different threshold levels, the fraction of the composition is indicated as follows: 0.54% porosity, 60.58% fiber, and 38.88% matrix. The composition of the specimen is close to the value in the technical data sheet from the maker (Delta-Tech, Italy). Therefore, the proposed basic image processing techniques can identify through-thickness porosity. Moreover, this work suggests a configuration for visible void measurement to present void properties.

articleTitle: Factors of Maximizing Sales with Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This article begins by describing the evolution of AI as a key factor in the transformation of the e-commerce industry. Emphasis is placed on how AI technology has enabled innovative solutions that not only enrich the customer experience but also directly contribute to increased sales. It is explained that AI facilitates more sophisticated data analysis, allowing businesses to understand customer behavior more deeply and respond in a more accurate and personal way. Additionally, the article highlights how AI assists in automating business processes, reducing operational costs while increasing efficiency and speed of service, factors that are crucial for maintaining a competitive edge in the rapidly changing e-commerce market.

articleTitle: Purchasing Intention Factors for Electric Motorcycle in Indonesia: Content Analysis and Decision Tree Algorithm Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Research on purchasing intention factors for electric motorcycles is starting to develop along with the growth in the use of electric vehicles. The Indonesian government has issued a policy of providing incentives for those who buy electric motorcycles. This research aims to look at the patterns that occur in the purchasing intention of Indonesian people regarding incentives to buy electric motorcycles. This research uses a mixed method approach, which starts with content analysis via YouTube comments and then quantitative data processing using the Decision Tree Algorithm to see the patterns that occur. The research was conducted in two large provinces in Indonesia, namely DKI Jakarta and West Java, with 200 respondents aged 18-35 who currently own a motorcycle. The results of this research show that there is an important influence of the incentives given on purchase intention, and knowledge of the advantages and benefits of electric motorcycles is an important consideration for consumers in making purchases and taking advantage of the incentives given. This research is useful for electric vehicle knowledge, in developing new methods, and the findings can be used for consideration by stakeholders in formulating strategies for implementing the use of electric motorcycles in society.

articleTitle: Hybrid Ant Colony Optimization Method for the Traveling Salesman Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The traveling salesman problem (TSP) is a classic problem in computer science and operations research which involves finding the shortest possible route that visits a given set of cities. In this paper, we propose a hybrid algorithm for solving such problem. The algorithm combines the ant colony optimization (ACO) method with the 2-opt heuristic to improve the efficiency for solving the TSP. Instances from the TSPLIB were used to test the algorithm. The results showed that the hybrid ACO algorithm was more effective in solving the TSP as compared to the traditional ACO or the 2-opt heuristic methods.

articleTitle: The Integration of Critical Path Method and Multiple Skilled Workforce in the Repetitive Construction Project Management by Using Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research aims to solve the problem of repetitive construction of two-floor houses’ project by using the integration of critical path method and multiple skilled workforces to minimize the number of workers and to maximize the resource's utilization. The construction's activities network is developed on the Arena simulation software. The single skill and multiple skilled workforces for twenty houses construction project are simulated and compared. The results shown that the single skilled workforces use 25 workers with 58 percentage of idle cost while the multiple skilled workforces use 14 workers with 4.9 percentage of idle cost. For the case of partial multiskilling, the best solution is only 26.93 percentage of idle cost which is still better than single skilled case.

articleTitle: Development of a Linux Based ARP Poisoning Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The threat of man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks and Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) Poisoning has the potential to damage the integrity and privacy of computer networks, so this research is intended to develop an ARP Poisoning attack detection system. This system applies the ARP table inspection method on each host to identify discrepancies between IP and MAC addresses as an attack indicator to detect attacks without burdening the network. This research also utilizes ARP ping to speed up ARP table data collection. Tools such as Ettercap and Wireshark were used for testing, where the system was tested in three intercept scenarios, which included two HTTP and Telnet traffic scenarios and one HTTPS encrypted traffic scenario. As a result, the system successfully detects ARP Poisoning attacks in all scenarios and sends alerts via email to network administrators. This research finds that even though traffic can be intercepted, packet contents in encrypted scenarios such as HTTPS remain hidden, highlighting the importance of encryption in dealing with MITM attacks. The results of research using the ARP table inspection method have proven to be effective in detecting ARP Poisoning attacks and contributing to improving network security.

articleTitle: Comparison of Competency Assessment Before and After the Covid-19
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: National Institute of Technology, Sendai College, Hirose Campus is a five-year technical college (KOSEN) that trains students to become engineers in information and electronics. At Hirose Campus, we make efforts that the students not only acquire specialized knowledge and skills but also, they can develop their competencies, which will enable them to make full use of their specialized knowledge and skills after they graduate. Assessment of competencies is very important. We are continually assessing students by faculty using rubrics and standardized tests (PROG) as an objective assessment method. The continuous research with PROG began in 2014 and is used to visualize student growth characteristics and to improve education. In 2020, society has gone through a period of global infection by Covid-19, a state of emergency was declared, but now the so-called “with-corona policy” is underway. We consider it possible to observe the effects of the continuing research to date on student competencies in the Corona disaster. Though it has been a short period of time (a little over 2 years), we have been able to compare students' competency growth characteristics before and after Corona, as well as identify changes in the competencies of students who enrolled at this campus.

Author Keywords: Objective assessment of Generic Skills (Competency, Literacy)

articleTitle: Design of RBF-Based Adaptive Gain Fuzzy Sliding Mode Control for Uncertain Ball and Beam System
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study explores the application of sliding mode control to the ball and beam system, a widely studied subject. Sliding mode control, known for its robustness, simplicity, and adaptability, has been extended through combinations with techniques like radial basis function (RBF) networks and fuzzy logic. The primary focus here is enhancing the reaching phase in sliding mode control using RBF, integrating a power rate reaching law, and fuzzy logic to optimize controller performance. Adapting the controller for real-world scenarios requires precise knowledge of the ball and beam system parameters, achieved through an integral-based approach to parameter identification. The proposed controller is then implemented, with a comprehensive comparison conducted among various techniques based on their step response characteristics. Results show that the proposed RBF-based adaptive fuzzy sliding mode controller yields a 250% transient time decrease compared to the power-reaching law SMC and a tenfold decrease in overshoots.

articleTitle: Generation of Effective Bispectrogram for Classification of Environmental Sound Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The realization by computers of the ability to recognize sound environments as humans have is an important issue. Various applications are possible, such as environment recognition systems for robots and self-driving cars, audio support systems for hearing difficulties, and real and virtual classroom atmosphere analysis. For the problem of environmental sound classification, which is one area of the issue, many researchers proposed various methods using convolutional neural networks with spectrograms as input data. Although the neural network is powerful, its performance depends on the input data type. Slice bispectrograms, which are slices of the diagonal components of the short-time bispectrum, have been proposed. In order to improve the classification accuracy, we propose several new methods for generating more effective bispectrograms. In this paper, after explaining the principle of the proposed bispectrograms, we clarify their characteristics and effectiveness based on evaluating the results of sound classification experiments.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality Training for Line Production of Car Parts: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This paper introduces virtual reality (VR) technology to simulate a virtual work environment to improve the problem of reducing new car paint factory employees' training work. The creation of this VR simulation system began with interviews with factory engineers about the work processes. Then, a 3D model was created to assemble the entire production line with a game engine and a virtual physics system used in the actual location. In terms of evaluation of the system, the pre-test/post-test method was conducted to analyze and evaluate the performance of new employees. Our empirical study reveals that the proposed VR technique can explore improved training activity. The accuracy rate increased from 16.67% to 93.33%, and the ability to produce parts was more rapid, from 75 seconds to 42.85 seconds per part, compared to the standard training method for training by reading documents and testing a paper-based method. In addition, the data collection from VR practice can be used to create policies for upskilling and reskilling and to assess the potential of both new and experienced employees.

articleTitle: Design of Application Development Infrastructure Automation Tools on Kubernetes Using Python
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: PT XYZ is a software-based service company, In the development of PT XYZ applications, there are many stages, With many of these stages, the development time becomes inefficient, such as the infrastructure creation stage, where the developer team does not have access to infrastructure creation and the developer team needs to wait for the infrastructure team to create the application infrastructure, This research aims to reduce the time spent waiting for the developer team to create infrastructure. This research uses the Python programming language as the main programming language. The research was conducted using the waterfall method, data sampling with interviews and field observations, and then the features will be tested using the Blackbox testing method. The result of this research is to replace one stage with a more effective one to reduce the number of infrastructures works from 1.2 hours to 6.5 minutes.

articleTitle: Integrated Online Scheduling System for Church Services with SMS Notification and QR Code Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: There are many scheduling systems developed this pandemic. The integrated online scheduling system for churches is an example of a scheduling system. This paper presents an online web-based system where it provides convenience specifically for churchgoers who have a hard time setting an appointment or go to the church due to the pandemic, developed using agile framework. This study identified all the necessary requirements, which leads to customer requirements and to further validate and implement the system application. This study, therefore, is set to examine the factors that shape the user acceptance of the said online web-based system. Such factors as functionality, reliability, usability, and efficiency. A quantitative descriptive was employed to define acceptability. Results show that the online web-based system has positive impressions on the functionality, reliability, usability, and efficiency.

articleTitle: Students' Suggestions Regarding Japanese Online Extensive Reading Conducted as an Out-of-Classroom Activity
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The purposes of this study were 1) to examine the results of a questionnaire administered after online extensive reading as an out-of-classroom activity from a motivational perspective and to identify the factors that lead to many of the readings. 2) To clarify whether there is a difference in the factors that influence reading more online between the upper group and the lower group, and if so, what factors are responsible for this difference. The sample includes 352 second-year students in the second semester of 2022 academic year. The data was collected by using 29 items online questionnaire about students' suggestions regarding Japanese online extensive reading from September 1 - 16, 2022. The data analyses were based on frequency, percentage, mean, standard deviation, and T-test. The analysis resulted in categorizing into five groups. From this, it was found that the primary motivation for students to engage in extensive reading was related to scores and grades. Furthermore, the items that showed differences between the upper group and the lower group were 10 items in which upper group students felt that their Japanese language proficiency improved through extensive reading. This result indicates that students in the lower groups need support from their teachers.

articleTitle: UX Analysis on Social Health Insurance Administration Body (Mobile JKN) Using Honeycomb and Eye-Tracking Method
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Mobile JKN is an application developed by the government of the Health Insurance Administration Body (BPJS) to facilitate users in obtaining information and services related to National Health Insurance. This research uses a qualitative data approach obtained from the results of the eye-tracking method. Then, to strengthen the analysis results, research was carried out using UX Honeycomb to obtain quantitative data by conducting a questionnaire distributed to Mobile JKN users. The analysis results from the Eye Tracking method show that 73% engagement from UXReality it is necessary to improve 3 features, namely, JKN Service Complaints, Doctor Consultations, and FAQs of Mobile JKN, and each aspect of the UX Honeycomb shows an average of 3.44 that Mobile JKN is said to be suitable for use as an application. Apart from that, many suggestions and inputs for further application development exist. The academic implication is to make contributions based on a combination of methodologies. The practical implication is that the Health Insurance Administration Body (BPJS) can improve the experience of Mobile JKN users, strengthen relationships with users, and improve Mobile JKN services.

articleTitle: Ship Fixed Route Selection Analysis Using ANP-BCOR Method: Case Study of Surabaya Shipping Company
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Increasing shipping companies in Indonesia annually makes competition in the shipping world tighter. This increase also changes company competition into competition between supply chains, which causes companies to be able to operate effectively and efficiently. One way is to choose the right route for the ship. This research was conducted on one of the shipping companies in Surabaya, which has a type of bulk carrier ship. The company's ships have three different routes with different travel times and different transportation costs on each trip. This research uses the Analytical Network Process - Benefit, Opportunity, Cost, Risk (ANP-BCOR) method. In this study, 5 criteria were used with 16 sub-criteria that were taken into consideration by the company in choosing a shipping route, also using BCOR as a primary network. Results show that in user-defined category, Adang Bay-Cialacap route has the highest value, while in the additive negative, the Adang Bay-Cilacap route has the highest value, and the result of multiplicative shows that the Muara Java route has the highest value. In addition, the sub-criteria of travel length, order completion ability, and order fulfillment rates are the sub-criteria that have the highest weighting values.

articleTitle: How Well-Being is Influenced by Government Subsidies and Level of Education in Indonesia (2018-2021)
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Well-being, is an important indicator in human life. It includes physical, mental, economic, and social aspects. Government social programs and education levels have a significant role in shaping the well-being of individuals and society as a whole. Government social programs, such as universal health programs, social assistance, and psychological services, can improve the physical and mental well-being of citizens. They help in addressing economic disparities and unequal access to health and education services. Education levels also play a key role in improving individual well-being. A quality education can open up better economic opportunities, improve understanding of health and nutrition, and help individuals develop important social skills. The combination of effective social programs and high levels of education can create a healthier, smarter and happier society overall. In view of this, further research and investment in these two areas can contribute positively to society's well-being.

articleTitle: Effects of Using AI Tools to Assist Students in English Essay Writing
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study aimed to examine the impact of integrating AI tools to support students in their English essay writing endeavors, alongside exploring innovative approaches to enhancing English writing instruction. The research involved 643 first-year students enrolled in the ENL-112 course during the second semester of the 2023 academic year. A sample of 130 students was selected through the Simple Random Sampling Technique. Data collection utilized a rating scale and an open-ended questionnaire, covering demographic information, the effects of AI tools on English essay writing, and student opinions and suggestions. Analysis techniques included frequency, percentage, mean, standard deviation, and content analysis. Results revealed students’ highest agreement levels in Educational Impact, followed by the Effectiveness of AI Tools in English Essay Writing, User Experience, and Usage Problems. Additionally, students provided diverse opinions and suggestions, with positive feedback from 18 students (13.85%), negative feedback from 10 students (7.69%), and valuable suggestions from 15 students (11.54%).

articleTitle: Analysis Effects of ChatGPT Towards Education in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In recent years, the advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) technology has revolutionized various sectors, including education. This innovative tool aims to enhance students’ understanding of academic subjects, providing personalized guidance and support. In Indonesia, where education plays a crucial role in national development, exploring the impact of ChatGPT on students’ learning experiences and outcomes becomes imperative. This study aims to fill this gap by reviewing the available literature in the broad field of chatbot technology in the education sector, identifying journals and studies related to chatbot technologies in Indonesia. In this study, we will explore some of the research and applications of chatGPT in Indonesia, as well as explaining the positive and negative impacts of implementing ChatGPT.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Computer Networks to Analyze Traffic Flow by Utilizing a Network Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research discusses the analysis and design of computer networks, which aim to reduce traffic problems in network infrastructure. This research uses NDLC as a methodology by utilizing the Network Monitoring System to analyze and monitor network performance. NMS is used to collect network traffic data, analyze traffic patterns, identify the causes of problems, and provide solutions to optimize traffic flow. This paper examines the existing network infrastructure at PT TD Automotive Compressor Indonesia, including network topology, network devices used, and network configuration and settings. Next, a more efficient and optimal network design is carried out to overcome the identified traffic problems. The data collection method used in this research involves collecting data through observation, interviews, literature study, and network performance measurement. The collected data is then analyzed using appropriate techniques and tools, including NMS. The results of this paper can also provide recommendations and solutions that PT TD Automotive Compressor Indonesia can implement to improve network efficiency and performance and reduce traffic problems. Thus, this paper is essential to computer network management and traffic flow optimization.

articleTitle: Uncovering the Impact of Digital Mastery on Learning Agility in Electronics Manufacturing Companies
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In dealing with continuous changes and business competition, companies are forced to adapt effectively and quickly. Learning agility and digital mastery of all employees are becoming crucial capabilities. This article attempts to uncover the impact of digital mastery on learning agility. A survey-based quantitative study that involved 261 employees from some major electronics manufacturing companies in Bekasi (Jawa Barat, Indonesia) was conducted to examine the developed hypotheses. SEM PLS analysis employing SmartPLS application version 4.0 concludes that digital communication and digital strategic skills have a positive impact strongly on all aspects of learning agility. Meanwhile, content creation skills do not. Uncovering content creation opportunities in electronic manufacturers is recommended for gaining a higher level of learning agility.

articleTitle: Design of an Infusion Capacity Monitoring System for Patients Based on the Internet of Things in Hospitals
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The patient's infusion fluid will only be changed if the nurse changes it or based on information from the patient's family. The research method used in terms of fluid volume utilizes the function of the Arduino microcontroller as the brain, the load cell sensor as an infusion fluid weight detector connected to the IoT, fuzzy logic calculations on the infusion volume weight measuring device in line with real-time decision-making when reading gram weight changes with sensors, and the system development method using a prototype model. The test results of three infusion bottles containing mineral water with a liquid volume of 500 ml and a load cell sensor as an infusion weight detector can be accepted by the Arduino Wemos D1 as a load cell sensor processing component. The infusion liquid weight data is uploaded to the MySQL database, and a notification is sent and displayed on the smartphone when the infusion volume reaches 12% of its weight. The results of this study indicate that the design of tools connected to applications on smartphones can work well and facilitate the process of monitoring infusions for patients in real-time

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis on the E-Learning System Maturity of Four HEIs Amidst the Pandemic for Government Application for Distance Learning Education
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The study focused on the e-Learning system maturity of the four campuses of the Lyceum of the Philippines University amidst the COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines, anchored on Dr. Stephen Marshall's e-Learning Maturity Model (eMM) version 2.0. Data were collected through Google Forms from students and faculty, selected using simple random sampling based on a set of criteria, who used e-learning systems during the First Semester of Academic Year 2022-2023. A 4-point Likert Scale metrics was used and data gathered were analyzed using Statistical Package for Social Science (SPSS) version 22. Responses were categorized as fully adequate, largely adequate, partially adequate, and not adequate. To test its normality, Kolmogorov-Smirnov was used. However, it was not satisfied, producing a non-normally distributed data set. Thus, a non-parametric test called Kruskal Wallis was used to compare. The study revealed that there is high significant difference in the maturity of e-learning systems across four campuses on five key process areas: learning, development, support, evaluation, and organization. LPU-Batangas has the most mature e-learning systems, followed by LPU-Manila, LPU-Cavite, and LPU-Laguna. Consequently, a development program is proposed which may help the campuses continuously improve their e-learning systems and prepare the government's application for distance education program.

articleTitle: User Experience Evaluation of Learning Management System of SD Islam Al Azhar 45 Palembang with PACMAD Model
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: There are many educational institutions using LMS to support the teaching and learning process, and SD Islam Al Azhar 45 Palembang is one of those. The goal of this study is to assess the user experience by evaluating its usability. The subjects of this study are a group of students consisting of eighty-six students and a group of teachers consisting of twelve teachers. The model used in this study is People at the Center of Mobile Application Development (PACMAD). This study shows that five of the seven attributes of PACMAD have a good score. Those good attributes are effectiveness, efficiency, learnability, memorability, and error-tolerance. Two attributes: satisfaction and cognitive load both have a bad score. The satisfaction attribute got a 59.92 average score, and the cognitive load attribute got a 57.49 average score. The improved prototype is made based on this result, and that prototype is evaluated by interviewing six students and three teachers. The evaluation of the prototype shows that the prototype has a better user experience score (8.11) compared to the old UI (6.67) for both groups.

articleTitle: Differences in Adaptation of Digital Education Between BINUS University and Wakayama University
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic accelerated technological progress, with no signs of slowing down post-pandemic. Educators worldwide adapted to technology differently before, during, and after the crisis. This study explores the challenges faced by teachers in online instruction and seeks mutual learning opportunities between BINUS University and Wakayama University. The research aims to guide teachers struggling with the transition to digital classrooms. The data was gathered through a survey that allows short-essay-like answers in order to go in-depth with the target participants' reasoning. Results from both universities revealed that some teachers still prefer offline classes due to better teacher-student connections. However, there's growing interest in hybrid learning for its potential to enhance learning conditions. Educators see it as a flexible approach, allowing seamless transitions between in-person and online modes based on circumstances. The study emphasizes preparedness for future developments in online education. Both universities should plan for potential advancements to ensure adaptability and quality education. Ultimately, this study aims to provide valuable insights and support to teachers adapting to the digital classroom, fostering resilience and effectiveness in teaching in the face of evolving technology. The following research study can address the issue of what digital literacy skills training and tasks can be enhanced to help this study author become an effective facilitator in the hybrid classroom.

articleTitle: Improving Performance of Ternary Tree Algorithm Using Adaptive Group Splitting Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This paper presents technique for improving the performance of Ternary tree algorithm. In order to avoid the collision, Ternary tree algorithm divides the users involved in collisions into 3 groups. However, in the case of continuous collisions, keeping the number of divided groups equal to 3 all the time may cause an inefficient use of channel. This is because in later collisions there are fewer users involved in the collision. Dividing the number of groups to 2 in later collisions can provide better performance. Therefore, this paper proposes Adaptive Group Splitting technique to improve the channel access efficiency of Ternary tree algorithm. In Adaptive Group Splitting Technique, the threshold value is defined as the number of collisions in a continuous collision that start to change the number of divided groups from 3 to 2. From the results, we found that the threshold value is an important parameter and affects the system performance. When we use the appropriate threshold value Adaptive Group Splitting technique can help reduce the number of idle slots and improve the performance of Ternary tree algorithm. Especially in the case where there are a large number of users in the system.

articleTitle: Technology in Education: Moolang Virtual Classroom as an Alternative for Sustainable Education to Enhance Learning Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The use of technology is expected to improve student learning outcomes. This research aims to determine the differences in learning outcomes of students who study using Moolang Virtual Classroom with the application of Direct Lecturing and Problem-Based Learning. The method in this research uses a 2-way quasi-experimental ANOVA and a gain score test to determine the effectiveness of applying the technique. The population in this study consisted of ten classes, and the research sample consisted of two classes based on the purposive sampling technique of paying attention to certain characters. To determine the learning outcomes of this Indonesian Economics Course, students will be evaluated based on their level of economic literacy. The results of the Gain Score Test on the PBL method show quite effective results, namely 58%, and the Gain Score test on Direct Lecturing shows less effective results with a result of 42%. The interaction between method and level of economic literacy shows that learning methods influence 50.7%, while other factors are influenced by motivation. The researcher gives some advice. to future researchers, they can use another learning method to improve critical thinking and learning outcomes. Future researchers can use some teaching environments to give students new experiences.

articleTitle: System Evaluation on the Bank Jago Application Using the Usability Testing Method
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The widespread adoption of banking and financial applications underscores the need for user-friendly, secure and efficient interfaces. This study uses usability testing methods to evaluate the Bank Jago application, aiming to provide insights not only for application developers but also users and the digital banking sector. This evaluation aims to improve user experience, address security issues, and contribute to the application's competitiveness in the dynamic digital banking landscape. This phase includes the preparation of test materials, including scenarios in the Jago application, designed so that participants can interact clearly within the specified test scope. The results, as illustrated in the figure, include responses from 112 participants who completed the questionnaire survey. Of these respondents, 59 people were in the age range 28–48 years, while the remaining 53 were aged between 17–27 years. Meanwhile, the level of user satisfaction with the Jago application based on the results of the System Usability Scale is at 55.73 which is in the “unacceptable” category with a score of “F”, adjective ratings and acceptance ranges that fall into the marginal category. By highlighting user preferences, UI improvement recommendations include but are not limited to combining multiple features into one, screen simplification, and accessibility.

articleTitle: Automatic Building Structure Classifier for Photographs to Understand the Exterior Design Features of Houses from an Age Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: While the physical structure influences the external design decisions, the structure alone does not determine the design. There are attempts to incorporate design features that are typical of other structures. In this paper, for buildings, cases where there is no direct relationship between structure and appearance are extracted and organized along a time axis. In order to extract cases where the exterior is not related to the structure, we use an image recognizer based on deep learning. Cases where the structure cannot be inferred from a photograph of a building are considered to have an appearance that is atypical for that structure. We also compared the training time between fine-tuning a pre-trained model as a classification model and building a CNN model from scratch with a small number of layers. It was found that a CNN with a short training time can achieve an accuracy that seems sufficient for the purpose of the analysis.

articleTitle: Bottom Bar vs Hamburger Navigational Menu Design: A Comparative Analysis in Coffee Shop Mobile Application Using the SUS Methodology
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The growth of application usage is steadily expanding. The global count of mobile application downloads has been consistently rising since 2016, reaching over 255 billion by 2022. The coffee shop industry has also experienced a significant impact from the surge in mobile application usage. Data from 2021 reveals that the majority of food and beverage orders originate from mobile applications. The heightened utilization of mobile applications in the coffee shop industry encouraged the innovation of enhanced features to improve customer experience. This research aims to investigate the user experience differences between the usage of the hamburger menu and bottom bar menu designs in a mobile application in a coffee shop case study. The study offers recommendations from its findings for practitioners in the coffee shop industry and further research. The research utilized the System Usability Scale (SUS) methodology, incorporating tools such as task scenarios and questionnaires. Results revealed a 99 percent task completion rate for the bottom bar navigation design in the coffee shop mobile app, while the hamburger menu navigation design achieved a 98 percent completion rate. In conclusion, the bottom bar navigation design proves to be more effective in aiding users in task completion compared to the hamburger menu.

articleTitle: Retrieval Augmented Generation Based Thai Question-Answering System
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This paper proposes a Thai Question-Answering System, specifically developed by using the Computer Engi-neering curriculum at Srinakharinwirot University, Thailand. The proposed system integrates the OpenThaiGPT model within a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework to generate contextually accurate responses to user queries. To evaluate the system, a set of 41 questions are categorized into basic, intermediate, and advanced levels, employing both zero-shot and few-shot learning techniques to assess its performance. The experimental results show that few-shot prompting exhibits efficacy across most criteria and complex-ity levels. However, challenges in maintaining this efficacy were observed, particularly regarding the accuracy of responses. This highlights areas that require future improvement.

articleTitle: User-Generated Content and Competitive Landscape of Batik as Cultural Business Product to Identify Unique Selling Points: A Data-Driven Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Batik, an intricate traditional textile art form, holds a special place in Indonesian culture. Despite its aesthetic and cultural appeal, there has been limited research exploring its unique selling points from a consumer's perspective for user-generated content. This study aims to fill this gap by employing machine learning algorithms for sentiment analysis and utilizing an extended word frequency table. The findings reveal that consumer perceptions of Batik extend beyond the product itself to include various factors such as pricing, location, shopping experience, and craftsmanship. These insights are particularly important for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in the Batik industry, offering them actionable strategies for market positioning. Additionally, the study contributes to the growing body of academic literature on cultural entrepreneurship, emphasizing the commercial potential of products rooted in local culture. The high accuracy of the sentiment analysis model further validates these findings, making them invaluable for both business owners and policymakers interested in promoting culturally significant industries.

articleTitle: Introducing Bibliobattle into Japanese Language Class in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In this paper, a workshop, which is designed based on a gamification theory, for students who learn Japanese language is mentioned. In this workshop, the participants enjoy a book review match, Bibliobattle, and try to win an international Bibliobattle competition, The world Bibliobattle championship. The workshop was held from 26 July to 13 September 2023 in Bangkok, Thailand. First, the formal rules of Bibliobattle and practices in which Bibliobattle is played in language classes are shown as the backgrounds. Then, the outline of the workshop is mentioned. Questionnaires were conducted to investigate the effects of the workshop. The results show that the workshop effected positively on the attitudes for learning of the participants.

articleTitle: Teachers's Perceptions of Using “Liveworksheets” in Chinese Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research aims to explore the teacher's perceptions of using “liveworksheets” in Chinese online learning. A worksheet is one of the learning tools needed to support the learning process using a scientific approach. The preparation of a worksheet is very important since it is intended to ease students understanding of the material taught in the learning process; hence, our research focused on teachers's perceptions of designing an e-worksheet. We used a qualitative method by interviewing eight participants who had experience using “Liveworksheets” in their teaching and learning processes before. The research result showed that the platform has many features that can create a very interactive worksheet, which makes the teaching and learning process more interesting. The automatic scoring system had many advantages compared to the conventional worksheet. Therefore, “Liveworksheets” is a very helpful tool in assisting Chinese online learning. Although there were some difficulties in creating worksheets, all the participants gave positive feedback about using “Liveworksheets” in their teaching process, and they also recommended the application for teachers to use in creating more interactive worksheets.

articleTitle: The Influence of Social Media and Curated Insights Website on Idea Generation and Entrepreneurial Intention
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The role of incubators at universities is to increase the capacity of students to become creative, competitive businesspeople and able to improve their business performance. Business incubator support is not only in the form of physical facilities, such as workspace, but there is business assistance by mentors and coaches who train students to improve their entrepreneurial abilities. In this research, idea generation is a skill needed for students' entrepreneurship journey. The focus of this research is on the role of social media, especially Instagram and TikTok, as well as Trend Hunter as a curated insights website in improving the ability of idea generation and entrepreneurial intention of business students at the Business Incubator in Bandung City, Indonesia. This research involved 205 business students, and the analysis method used PLS-SEM. The research results show that the use of social media and Trend Hunter is significant in enriching students' idea generation abilities. The positive and significant correlation between ideas generation and entrepreneurial intention indicates that the ability to generate new business ideas can influence students' intentions to become entrepreneurs. These positive results indicate that the use of technology for idea generation not only increases entrepreneurial skills, but also increases the entrepreneurial intention of students after graduating from college.

articleTitle: The Effect of Technology Experience and Satisfaction with Technology Towards Behavioral Intention in the Hotel Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The current technology advancement has grown rapidly which also occurs in the hotel industry. Many services in hotels are assisted by technology, whether in the form of applications, tangible facilities, or for system purposes. The main objective of this research is to assess the effect of Technology Experience and Satisfaction with Technology towards Behavioral Intention, especially in five-star hotels in Jakarta. The method of sampling used was random sampling with 190 respondents, conducted through a questionnaire and analyzed from the Likert Scale responses. The respondents were dominated by those aged 21–30 years, female, and students. The analysis method used is SEM-PLS (SMARTPLS4). The findings of the analysis indicate a strong and statistically significant relationship among all variables. The analysis of T-Statistics shows that all hypotheses have valid T-Statistics <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{(> 1.96, 5\%}$</tex> significance level) and P Value <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{(< 0.05).}$</tex> All variables have valid Cronbach's Alpha <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{(> 0.7)}$</tex> Composite Reliability <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{(> 0.7),}$</tex> and AVE <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{(> 0.5).}$</tex> The direct relationship between Technology Experience with Satisfaction with Technology and Behavioral Intention has a positive and significant effect. Satisfaction with Technology also has a positive and significant effect on Behavioral Intention. The indirect relationship between Technology Experience towards Behavioral Intention through Satisfaction with Technology has a positive and significant effect.

articleTitle: The Effect of Review Valence, Review Volume, and Product Type on Consumer Purchase Behavior in the Era of Electronic Word of Mouth
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study examines how product type, review valence, review volume and product type influence consumer purchase behavior in the context of electronic word-of-mouth (E-WOM) in this digitalization era. This study attempts to clarify how different product categories, review volumes, both positive and negative evaluations affect consumers decision-making processes in combination through a thorough examination. The goal of the research is to shed light on the dynamic nature of online consumer behavior and provide important insights into the complex dynamics influencing consumer decisions by examining these elements in the context of E-WOM. The methodology employed in this research uses a quantitative approach. A sample size of 280 respondents, comprising of Theme Park consumers, was selected randomly with purposive sampling techniques. The survey is distributed via online convenience sampling on Google Forms to gather insights directly from users. The research utilizes Partial Least Squares (PLS) as the data analysis technique. Review valence had a recurring major influence. Findings showed negative bias on the persuasiveness and perceived informational value of online reviews, which was significant for the uptake of information. The primary impact of review volume was shown to be considerable when mediated variables were considered. Product participation, being susceptible to interpersonal influence.

articleTitle: AssignEase: A Web Application for Streamlining Employee Assignment Management
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This paper presents the development of AssignEase, an innovative web solution developed to make managing staff assignments easier, which was developed using agile framework. Results show that the system is acceptable to the users, following the ISO 25010 software evaluation. It is designed to be easy to use for employers and employees tasking activities. It offers secure, personalized dashboards, role-based access control, automated reminders, escalations, analytics, and reporting tools. These features help employers measure team performance, task completion, and individual productivity. In addition, it makes it easy to track deadlines and progress reports and adapt to changes in staff requirements. Employees can access assignments from anywhere, track their progress, and securely collaborate with their colleagues. AssignEase simplifies the management of staff, making it efficient, and beneficial for everyone. This project presents some recommendations to enhance the features of the systems for successive iterative development.

articleTitle: Design of Luminance-Chrominance Gain Equalizer Using Uniformly Distributed RC Circuits
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The propose of this paper is to design the luminance-chrominance gain equalizer use in the video waveform transmission. As it is known, the conventional measurement and gain corrector of chrominance distortion equipment is not so simple. This network corrector has to use fillers and delay time to separate the luminance signal and chrominance signal by means of low-pass and high-pass filter in connection. Here in, we deploy the uniformly distributed RC circuit (URC). We introduce two types of equalizers. The first type is to correct the luminance signal without deteriorating the chrominance signal. The second type is designed to correct the chrominance signal with no effect to luminance signal. Both equalizers comprise of a few gain amplifiers and URC circuits. From the simulation results, it is shown that the frequency response of gain equalizer given good effective in correcting video signal distortion. We also introduce the modulated sine-squared pulse test signal for measuring and correcting the amount of low gain and high gain of the chrominance signal.

articleTitle: Designing Knowledge Management System for Performance Efficiency Based Chatbot at PT.XYZ
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Knowledge management has an important role in helping companies to solve challenges and increase their competitive strength. It is important to manage it effectively through a knowledge management system. Currently on PT.XYZ already using a knowledge management system to transfer knowledge. However, the existing system is not effective because it is hard to use and takes time to input articles on Knowledge Base Sharepoint (KBS). This research purpose is to solve current issues by designing new systems that integrate between chatbot-based artificial intelligence and KBS. New system can help increase efficiency in managing knowledge. Because employees feel like normal conversation and don't need to make an article. This chatbot integrates with Microsoft Teams as PT.XYZ daily communication platform. Chatbot system managed by Power Automate using automatic flow on incoming chat then integrated with KBS as an information source and integrated with Azure Cognitive Language Studio which analyzes data from question and answer using natural language processing. Results of the prototype show that the chatbot response time for questions asked is 2 minutes and for answers answered is 1 minute. Because of less effort meaning improvement in efficiency. Resulting employees can find and understand correct knowledge using keywords entered.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Consumer Analysis: ChatGPT's Application in Understanding Market Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research utilizes ChatGPT, an advanced AI tool, to analyze consumer behavior. It focuses on five key questions. The study explores product popularity, geographical customer distribution, sales trends over time, customer loyalty, and customer segmentation. Key findings include the PAC SDY product's high popularity despite a downward sales trend. The data also show the increasing sales of the SAD product. The study also highlights the Bandung area as the primary market. A significant number of transactions occurred in the early morning hours. Customer analysis based on usernames provides insights into customer loyalty and buying habits. The research also employs K-means clustering to segment customers into three categories – red, blue, and green clusters, based on their purchasing frequency and quantities. This segmentation provides a nuanced understanding of different customer behaviors and purchasing patterns.

articleTitle: Analysis and Development of Android Prototype Application Information System of Mobile Agrarian Reform “SIRAM”
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Directorate General of Agrarian Management the Ministry of Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning/National Land Agency is the ministry that handles agrarian reform activities in Indonesia, so far land survey activities carried out by surveyors to obtain Inventory Data on Ownership of Land Use and Utilization (DIP4T) by the ministry are still carried out manually. The purpose of this study is to identify, analyze, design, and develop an android application with the name Mobile Agrarian Reform Information System (SIRAM), in which the activity refers to the prototype method. The SIRAM application was created to assist the ministry in obtaining fast and precise data from surveyors to be sent to the head office. After the development is complete, black-box testing will be carried out to ensure that the SIRAM application is according to what is needed.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Knowledge Management in 3PM Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: 3PM Solution is one of the companies engaged in IT services. 3PM Solution has difficulty in managing organizational knowledge. The research objectives identify, analyze needs, and design knowledge management at 3PM Solution. The design uses the SECI Model which includes socialization, externalization, combination, and internalization and uses the knowledge management (KM) Cycle by Evans, Dalkir, and Bidian. This research provides insight to IT service companies on how to overcome the challenges of lack of documentation on projects. The study identifies that 3PM Solution requires documentation covering Project Documentation and Code Documentation. In response, we propose a design for a knowledge management system application to accommodate this documentation. By adopting the SECI model and the KM Cycle, companies can strengthen the flow of knowledge in projects, build a more solid knowledge base, and improve the efficiency of collaboration between project teams. Thus, the results of this study have the potential to support companies in overcoming knowledge-related barriers on IT service projects.

articleTitle: Development New LMS Framework for SMEs: A Guide to Transforming Microlearning in Small Business Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In the digital era that continues to develop, 3.79 million Indonesian MSMEs have gone online, but many have not been able to utilize technology properly. Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) need appropriate learning media and the location where SMEs are deployed. It makes it difficult for the government to carry out coaching and mentoring efficiently; apart from that, many of the designed learning media are still not in line with the needs of the actors. With the existence of Kampus-UKM.id, it is hoped that the actors can improve and UKM players can maximize their potential in this digital era. This paper presents an LMS framework tailored for SMEs, emphasizing the importance of microlearning. This framework is designed to optimize skills development and increase business growth for small and medium-sized businesses.

articleTitle: The Attempt to Assess the TOEIC Readiness and Increase the TOEIC Score of Sophomore at TNI Based On the Vocabulary Included in TOEIC Test from NGSLT
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: TOEIC is a standardized test which evaluates the test takers in listening and reading comprehension. This research focuses on the use of TOEIC wordlist from NGSLT and its application to improve the score of the students in non-English majors in the mandatory subject which aims to ensure the students reach at least the score 500 to be considered “ready” for job application. The purposes of this research are 1) to assess the lexical knowledge of the students in terms of TOEIC vocabulary, 2) to find out the number of students in each score ranges using pre-test and actual TOEIC test, and 3) to estimate the number of students who are potentially “ready”. In this research, the students who get a total score of 500 or above in pre-test and actual TOEIC test are considered ready. Additionally, the difference of 0-50 is the margin of error in measurement stated by ETS, which is used to ensure the reliability of the data. The instruments used in this research consist of pre-test, vocabulary exercises, and the actual TOEIC test. The whole process takes 4 months starting from having pre-test until the actual test. The results show that (1) the majority of the students who study ENL-212 potentially know at least 500 words from the 1000 essential words for TOEIC test, (2) the majority of the students in the pre-test ranges from 255-550 for a total of 65.920/0 while the majority of the students in the actual test is in the ranges of 205-450 for a total of 61.33%, 3) Only 182 students in the pre-test and 139 students in the actual test get into the range of 500-990 and only 167 students attain stable score among 481 students with only 0-50 difference when comparing the score from pre-test and actual test.

articleTitle: Factor Analysis of Information Technology Audit Competency in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Today's world has fully entered the digital era, whether doing business online, using digital money, or using widely used everyday life technology. However, although technology has enormous benefits, on the other hand, it can also have negative effects on users. Therefore, information Technology Auditors (IT Auditors) play a very important role in inspecting and giving recommendations on the safe use of technology. This research study aims to analyze factors of IT Audit Competency in Thailand. The tools used to collect data were in-depth interviews with 10 experts and an online questionnaire. (Questionnaire that has passed Reliability and Validity (IOC) from 5 experts) Statistics used in the analysis include mean, standard deviation, and analyzed for exploratory factors (Exploratory Factor Analysis) by analyzing KMO (Kaiser-Meyer-Olkin) and Bartlett's Test of Sphericity statistics. All obtained elements were also approved by the experts who attended the small discussion meeting (Focus Group Discussion). The research results found that three key factors consist of 1) Knowledge, 2) Skills, and 3) Attributes. There are a total of 23 sub-components.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis on BigSocial Applications Using the Usability Testing Method
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: BigSocial application is a social media analytics application that functions to analyze social media information. However, so far, the BigSocial application has never tested the level of user satisfaction (user experience) with the application. So, this study aims to determine the level of user satisfaction with the BigSocial application. The testing technique used is usability testing with variables measured including learnability, efficiency, memorability, errors, and satisfaction. The research method used is a quantitative method with instruments used in the form of questionnaires and interviews. The number of sample respondents at the questionnaire stage was 11 respondents, while at the interview stage, there were 3 respondents. BigSocial application usability satisfaction level was 74.9% which consisted of several variables, namely learnability with a value of 84.7%, efficiency with a value of 82.5%, satisfaction with a value of 80.4%, memorability with a value of 73% and errors with a value of 53.8%. Thus, the usability value of the BigSocial application is included in the “Good” category. Final evaluation of proposed user interface design recommendations can improve the user experience better.

articleTitle: Evaluating UX on JayJay Digital Career School Learning Management System Website Using Design Thinking Method
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The teaching and learning activities have evolved alongside information system technology. PT JayJay Edukasi is one of the companies providing Learning Management System services. Functionally, JayJay's LMS has been running quite well, but some students have complained about inefficiencies, making their experience less enjoyable. To address this, an analysis is conducted to evaluate the user interface and user experience of JayJay's LMS. This research aims to evaluate and improve the UI and UX of JayJay's LMS by providing a prototype solution using the Design Thinking method. The User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ) method was used in the analysis to determine user experience scores on JayJay's LMS. The results showed from 32 respondents, the mean score of attractiveness obtained 0.84 (below average), the perspicuity score 0.49 (poor), efficiency 0.60 (below average), dependability 0.93 (below average), stimulation 0.77 (below average), and novelty 0.09 (poor). Based on these issues, the solution proposed is to create a redesigned LMS prototype that focuses on adding a static navigation system, restructuring assignment pages, and introducing a community forum feature. User validation testing was conducted on the prototype by one persona, and the results were satisfying after improvements were made to the UI and UX of JayJay's LMS.

articleTitle: Exploration and Analysis of Generative Design Model Outcomes for Novel Multirotor Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Generative design models have emerged as powerful tools for innovative structures for multirotor aerial vehicles. This paper presents an in-depth analysis of generative design model outcomes applied to creating novel multirotor structures. The proposed method first uses Generative design to generate a new configuration octocopter that meets the design requirements, which include the initial computer aided design model, input parameters and constraints and exploration of the model outcomes through scoring and sorting techniques. The results show that model Outcome 1 for ABS and Outcome 3 for PLA are highlighted as the top choices, considering both mass and stress/displacement analyses. Finally, we select model outcome 3 as the best model design without compromising the strength of the structure, as shown in FEA results.

articleTitle: Development of the APASIBI Application as an Interactive Learning Media for Speech and Deaf Children Using the Interpolation Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: SIBI is used in daily learning and communication processes. To increase understanding of sign language, especially SIBI in communicating between deaf and speech impaired children, the APASIBI application needs to be developed. This application applies the Interpolation Search algorithm to search for words and was developed to make predictions when searching for one or more possible words as choices. If the word in question is in the selection, then the user can select that word. If the word in question is not in the prediction options, the user must write the next letter or character. Searching for signal words can be done more quickly, an appropriate algorithm is needed to help and make it easier to search for signal words, especially SIBI. This research aims to produce a SIBI sign language dictionary with input in the form of text and output in the form of video signs, so that speech and hearing-impaired children are able to learn basic sign language and are able to compose SPOK sentences, and also analyze the application as a learning medium. Learning media in the form of this application will apply the Interpolation Search algorithm to the search for SIBI signal words.

articleTitle: Exploring the Views of Thai Working Professionals on Online English Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Synchronous online learning refers to a mode of education where students and instructors participate in real-time interactions through digital platforms, typically at scheduled times. It promotes immediate engagement, feedback, and collaboration, enhancing the learning experience by fostering a sense of community and accountability. Thus, the purposes of this study were to explore the perceptions of Thai workforce engaged in online English study through Google Meet program and to analyze the challenges encountered during their online English learning experience. The participants were 53 Thai workers employed across various industries in Thailand. A combination of semi-structured interviews, an open-ended survey, and participant observation were employed to gather data. The results revealed that a majority of participants (73.6%) encountered no issues in their online learning experiences due to their familiarity with online meeting tools and the preparedness of learning devices. However, a notable portion (26.4%) acknowledged facing challenges, citing inadequate English proficiency for effective communication, occasional feelings of loneliness or drowsiness during online study sessions and conflicts between working schedules and class timetable.

articleTitle: The Antecedents of E-Satisfaction: Empirical Evidence from E-Grocery Company in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: E-grocery is a form of development of the “Connected Commerce Era,” driven by a pandemic that has caused a shift in people's behavior to become all digital. A previous study explained that there is a need to explore the antecedents of e- customer satisfaction in the e-grocery industry. Therefore, the novelty of this study is to examine how perceived price fairness, e- service quality, and perceived risk affect e-customer satisfaction in e-grocery users. The research method used is associative- quantitative, with the research analysis unit being a customer of 242 respondents from one of the e-grocery companies in Indonesia. The results of this study indicate that perceived price fairness, e-service quality, and perceived risk have a significant influence on e- customer satisfaction of 58.883, which is greater than the calculated f value of 2.64 and a sig value of 0.000, which is smaller than the alpha value of 0.05.

articleTitle: The Role of Social Media Marketing on Students' Intention to Read Online Newspapers
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The use of technology in all age groups is now unavoidable. Cellular phones are a type of technology that people commonly use in their daily lives. Even though the use of cellular phones is very massive, it is believed that it has not been utilized as a medium for seeking information and news. Based on data, the reading index for electronic media articles in Indonesia is still at a moderate level. Students' understanding of information search and selection remains weak in comparison to their understanding of information dissemination, which is because students understand the internet but only use it for social media. This study is interested in knowing what factors influence students' reading intentions to read online newspapers. Social media is a technological platform for communication that Using the SmartPLS program, we applied structural equation modeling (SEM) to ascertain the linear relationship between the variables in this study. community cooperation by utilizing online apps and systems.
